jobs.title: Thai Language Transcription Expert
jobs.excerpt: Join our team as an Independent Contractor for Project Lupin.
jobs.description:
Join our team as an Independent Contractor for Project Lupin.
Project Lupin aims to help improve AI-powered speech recognition models
In this project, participants contribute by checking and modifying the audio segmentation and transcription. The transcriptions generated will contribute to the development of improved AI-powered speech recognition models.

Project Benefits

-Flexible hours – Work on your own schedule
-Remote – Work from anywhere
-Fair pay globally – Always above minimum wage in your market
-Scalable earnings – The more you work, the more you earn

Task Summary

You will listen to real audio recordings and produce precise, verbatim transcripts — capturing not just what was said, but how it was said. That means every “uh,” every repeated word, and every trailing sentence matters. Your work will include:

• Verbatim transcription with a target of 98%+ accuracy
• Timestamping segments with less than 500ms deviation
• Speaker labeling for conversations with 2 to 8 participants
• Event annotation for non-speech elements (e.g., laughter, background noise, unintelligible audio)

Requirements

  • Native-level fluency in Thai, including familiarity with regional accents and informal speech
  • Strong listening comprehension and attention to detail.
  • Ability to produce verbatim transcriptions, including stutters, repetitions, and filler words.
  • Experience in transcription, annotation, or linguistics is an advantage.
  • Comfortable using browser-based tools (training will be provided).
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Access to a laptop or desktop computer (mobile devices are not supported).
  • Reliable availability for minimum 10+ hours per week.

Please Note

This project follows a first-come, first-served approach and operates with demographic quotas to ensure fair and balanced representation across all participant groups. As a result, some individuals may not receive a task assignment if their group has already been filled.
This role is a project-based opportunity with CrowdGen, where you will join the CrowdGen Community as an Independent Contractor. If selected, you will receive an email from CrowdGen regarding the creation of an account using your application email address. You will need to log in to this account and reset the password, complete the setup requirements, and proceed with your application for this project-based role.
Join us in shaping the future of voice AI. Your participation in Project Lupin will directly help improve how technology understands and responds to real human speech.

jobs.title: Director of Global Trade Compliance
jobs.excerpt: Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions.
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart. 

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Voyager Technologies is seeking a Director of Global Trade Compliance to lead the company's international trade compliance strategy and operations. This role oversees compliance with export controls, import regulations, sanctions, customs requirements, and other cross-border trade laws, ensuring Voyager can operate confidently and efficiently as it grows its global footprint. The Director of Global Trade Compliance will serve as the Export Control Officer and empowered official for the company and will be responsible for overseeing and executing all matters related to trade compliance.

The position reports to the Chief Legal Officer and is part of the Legal department. This is a remote position.

In this role, the essential functions are:

  • Own and evolve the company's global trade compliance program, including export controls (ITAR/EAR), import/customs compliance, sanctions (OFAC), and anti-boycott regulations
  • Develop and implement policies, procedures, and internal controls to ensure compliance across all jurisdictions where Voyager operates or sells
  • Oversee product/technology classification (ECCN, USML, HTS) and manage the licensing process for exports, re-exports, and transfers
  • Manage import compliance activities, including customs valuation, country-of-origin determinations, tariff classification, and duty management
  • Lead screening processes for denied/restricted parties, sanctioned countries, and embargoed entities across sales, procurement, and partnerships
  • Conduct risk assessments and internal audits of trade compliance controls; drive remediation of identified gaps
  • Lead responses to compliance incidents, including voluntary self-disclosures and government inquiries
  • Advise leadership and cross-functional teams (engineering, sales, supply chain, M&A) on trade compliance risks tied to new products, markets, partnerships, and international hires
  • Build, mentor, and manage a growing trade compliance team as the function scales

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

  • Required:

    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
    • 8+ years of experience in global trade compliance, export controls, or customs, ideally in aerospace, defense, or advanced technology
    • Strong operational knowledge of ITAR, EAR, OFAC sanctions programs, and U.S. customs/import regulations
    • Direct experience interfacing with BIS, DDTC, CBP, or OFAC
    • Strong cross-functional communication skills and comfort advising senior executives

    Preferred:

    • Experience in the space, satellite, or defense sectors
    • Certification such as Certified U.S. Export Compliance Officer (CUSECO) or Certified Customs Specialist
    • Experience with global expansion, M&A due diligence, or multinational supply chains

The good faith base salary rangefor this role is $200,000 - $230,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families, with a significant portion of premiums covered by the company and many benefits paid at 100% for employees
  • Flexible, affordable gym memberships with 12,700+ options nationwide, including 24 Hour Fitness, EoS Fitness, Crunch Fitness, Anytime Fitness, Blink Fitness, Chuze Fitness, and more! No long-term contracts and FREE on-demand workout videos before you enroll
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a 50% company match on contributions up to 8%, supporting long-term financial security
  • Company wellness programs that support physical and mental well-being
  • Additional voluntary benefits and employee support resources
  • The opportunity to work alongside a highly talented team in an innovative, mission-driven environment

Voyager is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law. 

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Parts 120–130) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) (15 CFR Parts 730–774), applicants for this position must be a U.S. Person: a US Citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or a protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3). Applicants must be eligible to obtain any required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or the U.S. Department of Commerce.

Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran

It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all job duties, responsibilities, and requirements. This job description is not an employment agreement or contract. jobs.title: Manager, Client Onboarding & Operations
jobs.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are looking for a Manager, Client Onboarding & Operations who is a self-starter energized by working with clients and building strong relationships both externally and internally to drive exceptional outcomes for our clients and members. In this role, you will own the entire onboarding and deployment of the Twin program(s) end-to-end and assist the client growth team with program management. The ability to problem solve, analyze and troubleshoot with strong verbal and written communication skills, tailored to communicate based on the situation and audience in a fast paced environment will be key.

Working with a complex clinical delivery model in a high-growth environment, our Manager, Client Onboarding & Operations has to expertly navigate through ambiguity while managing internal and external teams in a highly detail-oriented, organized and structured manner - all while ensuring we deliver on-time and exceed client expectations. As part of our small and growing team, your input and contributions will be critical to helping Twin continuously improve, optimize and scale our onboarding process.

You should be a highly organized, client-focused and a resourceful individual. This role will be a great fit for you if you are a doer who is passionate about making a difference, comfortable with ambiguity, and naturally collaborative.

Responsibilities

Drive Client Value

  • Establish and maintain highly effective relationships with key stakeholders, executives and the C-suite across large enterprise clients
  • Develop fluent understanding of Twin Health programs, onboarding processes, ongoing program management, growth marketing approach and clinical operations
  • Successfully onboard Twin’s program(s) end-to-end across a portfolio of Twin clients, including self-insured employers, health plans and health systems
  • Lead discovery sessions to gain insight into Twin’s clients’ culture, priorities, and goals in order to design tailored solutions that work for their populations
  • Program manage and assist Twin’s Client Growth team with ongoing client support post-launch
  • Provide consultative recommendations to increase member engagement, enhance program results, and optimize overall client satisfaction
  • Perform and lead the setup, configuration, and testing of client instances to ensure proper functionality
  • Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects
  • Train clients on Twin programs to drive awareness and enrollment
  • Analyze client data pre and post launch to provide actionable insights for internal teams and clients

Deliver Project Management Excellence

  • Manage multiple complex projects simultaneously - setting expectations, managing overall project plan, and managing cross-functional teams to ensure timeliness and launch readiness
  • Effectively manage client stakeholders throughout onboarding, including leading client meetings, setting and managing expectations, building stakeholder alignment, and managing risks and escalations
  • Work with the clients technical leads (or 3rd parties) to operationalize data access and eligibility file management, including finalizing file/data requirements, setting up file transfer and validation, and ongoing issue resolution
  • Prepare, execute and participate in special events held for or hosted by clients
  • Prepare presentations and reports in a consumable client format that delivers actionable insights post launch
  • Manage project expectations through regular meetings, project status reports and maintaining great relationships
  • Build out standard onboarding work, templates, playbooks and internal cross-functional SOP’s to drive continuous improvement and best practice development in our approach

Lead Cross-functionally

  • Manage client issues/escalations and mobilize internal teams such as Client Growth, Client Integration, Clinical Delivery, Product, Member Operations and Business Development, to drive resolution
  • Work cross-functionality with teams such as Clinical Delivery, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Billing Operations and Executive teams to ensure client/market feedback is shared for ongoing improvements
  • Partner with Member Marketing to develop pre-launch member promotional strategies and toolkits that will increase member engagement, enhance program results, and optimize overall client satisfaction
  • Provide input and recommendations for improvements for internal processes to provide efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Serve as internal team SME/point person to ensure efficiency and consistency across the onboarding lifecycle
  • Drive internal alignment and manage cross-functional teams to ensure successful launches

Qualifications

  • 5 - 10 years of onboarding, program management and client facing experience
  • 5 - 10 years of digital health client onboarding and project management experience (manager level or above)
  • Experience with health benefits, health and wellness, health plans or systems
  • Ability to communicate and work across client organizations, engaging on a range of tactical and strategic issues, with senior executives as well as execution teams
  • Exceptionally strong project management skills, with demonstrated organizational skills, high attention to detail and ability to balance between thoughtful planning and timely execution
  • Ability to manage conflicting priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment working under time constraints
  • Proficiency with Google applications, PM tools, such as InspirePlanner, Monday.com, and MS Project
  • Experience working with technical/data teams (internal and external) on data exchange, file specifications, file encryption and transmission and testing

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $145,000-$160,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, clients and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Annual bonus based on personal and organizational metrics

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator II – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to provide administrative and technical support to the Project Team. As a Clinical Operations Delivery Associate II, you'll support audit readiness by ensuring files are reviewed according to the schedule detailed in the organization's SOP and department guidance document. You will provide administrative support for site activation activities and aid in the development of the critical path for site activation within assigned projects to support rapid site activations. Representing the organization in the global medical research community, you may develop collaborative relationships with investigators and site personnel to conduct feasibility assessments in accordance with feasibility processes and within deliverable timelines. You may develop a local knowledge base of sites in the respective market through collaboratively working with local company personnel. Additionally, you may utilize local knowledge, organization systems, external site lists, and sponsor directives to develop and review site lists that are suitable for the strategic needs of feasibility activities and to provide local input into the site tiering process. You may act as a buddy during the onboarding phase, support training of new staff, and participate in departmental initiatives to aid in process improvements and enhancements.

    •Trains new personnel in processes and systems.

Ensures (e)TMF is up to date by following file review schedules and documenting findings in appropriate system(s).
    •May provide system support (i.e., Activate & eTMF).

AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details


The Compliance Pharmacy Licensing Analyst is responsible for managing and maintaining business, pharmacy, pharmacist, pharmacy technician, wholesale, and other healthcare-related licenses, registrations, and permits across multiple jurisdictions. This role ensures ongoing compliance with federal, state, and regulatory requirements by coordinating licensing activities, monitoring regulatory changes, maintaining accurate records, and supporting audits and inspections.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in regulatory compliance within a healthcare, pharmacy, or pharmaceutical environment.


Responsibilities


  • Prepare, submit, track, and renew pharmacy, pharmacist, pharmacy technician, and other healthcare-related licenses, permits, and registrations.
  • Maintain accurate licensing records, databases, and documentation. Monitor license expiration dates and ensure timely renewals.
  • Coordinate with state boards of pharmacy, regulatory agencies, and third-party licensing vendors.
  • Research licensing requirements for new jurisdictions, business locations, and services.
  • Assist in investigating and resolving licensing discrepancies or compliance issues.
  • Maintain licensing and compliance databases.
  • Prepare reports and metrics regarding licensing status, renewals, inspections, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze trends and identify potential compliance risks.
  • Ensure confidential information is maintained in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.
  • Partner with Legal, Operations, Human Resources, Credentialing, and Pharmacy leadership to support licensing and compliance initiatives.
  • Provide guidance to managers and employees regarding licensing requirements.
  • Support onboarding activities requiring professional licensure verification.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The Data Quality Analyst will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for establishing and operationalizing data quality practices across CMM data domains and systems to accelerate CMM modernization efforts. The role defines, implements, monitors, and continuously improves data quality rules, controls, metrics, and processes to ensure data is accurate, complete, consistent, timely, valid, unique, and fit for its intended purpose.   • Establish data quality remediation processes and track issues through resolution.
  • Monitor data quality against established thresholds and service-level expectations.
  • Implement automated data quality checks and controls where appropriate.
  • Define data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, validity, uniqueness, and integrity.

  • Identify recurring data quality issues and recommend processes, system, or governance improvements.
  • Collaborate with Data Governance and Metadata teams to align data quality rules with approved data standards, definitions, and business glossary terms.
  • Support development of data quality standards, policies, procedures, and operating practices.
  • Provide data quality reporting to governance councils and program leadership.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the CMM data quality maturity model.

Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role

We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Independently licensed and living in Maine — LCPC, LMFT, LCSW or Licensed Psychologist

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 10 sessions with 15 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation

Up to $34,700.00 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities.

How We Support You

We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits

As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states

Our Community

Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.

Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!

With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

  • Our recruiters and other team members will only email you from or an @thriveworks.com email address.

  • Our interviews will take place over Google Meet (not Microsoft Teams, Zoom, or any other platform).

  • We will never ask you to purchase or send us equipment.

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to . You can contact with any questions or concerns.

Position Summary:

The Appeals & Grievances (A&G) unit manages Healthfirst member complaints, grievances and appeals that are presented by the member or provider pertaining to the authorization of or delivery of clinical and non-clinical services. A&G works in collaboration with divisions within and outside the organization to resolve issues in a timely and compliant manner.
The A&G Clinical Specialist is the subject matter expert responsible for all clinical case development and case resolution while ensuring compliance with Federal and/or State regulations. The incumbent will manage his/her own caseload and is accountable for investigating and resolving member or provider initiated cases. Manages all Department of Health (DOH) and executive complaints as needed. The incumbent may also handle clinical claim appeals that come from Healthfirst participating and non-participating providers.
This is either a remote or on-site position located at either the 100 Church Street location in New York City or the 1101 Greenwood Avenue location, Lake Mary, Florida. This position may require attendance at A&G/ Operations divisional meetings and Town Halls, some of which may require travel to one of the locations (T&E will be covered according to policy).

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for case development and resolution of clinical cases, such as: Pre-existing Conditions, Prior Approval, Medical Necessity, Pre-certification, Continued Stay, Reduction, Termination, and Suspension of services. The end to end process requires the Specialist to independently:
    • Research issues
    • Reference and understand HF’s internal health plans policies and procedures to frame decisions
    • Interpret regulations
    • Resolve cases and make critical decisions
    • Update file documentation such as the file notes and case summary
    • Manage all duties within regulatory timeframes
    • Communicate effectively to hand-off and pick-up work from colleagues
    • Work within a framework that measures productivity and quality for each Specialist against expectations
  • Prepare cases for Medical Director Review ensuring that all pertinent information (i.e. case summary, contract information, internal and external responses, diagnosis, and CPT codes and descriptions) has been obtained during investigation and is presented as part of the case
  • Prepare cases for Maximus Federal Services, Fair Hearing, and External Appeal through all levels of the appeal process
  • Additional duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

  • RN, LPN, & Dental Hygienist

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience in clinical practice with experience in appeals & grievances, claims processing, utilization review or utilization management/case management.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Utilization Review Guidelines (NYS ART 44 and 49 PHL), InterQual, Milliman or Medicare local coverage guidelines
  • Ability to work independently on several computer applications such as Microsoft Word and Excel, as well as corporate email and virtual filing system, (ie. Macess). Experience with care management systems, such as CCMS, TruCare and Hyland.

For more than 80 years, Kaplan has been a trailblazer in education and professional advancement. We are a global company at the intersection of education and technology, focused on collaboration, innovation, and creativity to deliver a best-in-class educational experience and make Kaplan a great place to work.

The future of education is here and we are eager to work alongside those who want to make a positive impact and inspire change in the world around them.

The Customer Success Manager (CSM) plays a pivotal role in driving retention and growth within Kaplan North America’s mid-tier supplemental education account portfolio. This is achieved through close partnership with sales leadership. Beyond retention efforts, the key function of the CSM role is account growth via strategic account planning, and the strategic identification and joint pursuit of cross-sell and upsell opportunities with sales counterparts. A Kaplan CSM is always looking for ways to turn mid-tier accounts into top-tier accounts, while managing the renewal cycle of assigned accounts within a dedicated book of business through an email and call cadence.

The CSM must have four essential skills to succeed in the role: communication and relationship building, problem-solving and adaptability, data analysis and technical proficiency, and a customer-centric mindset and proactive approach.

jobs.excerpt: About HeyGenAt HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all.
jobs.description:
About HeyGen

At HeyGen, our mission is to make visual storytelling accessible to all. Over the last decade, visual content has become the preferred method of information creation, consumption, and retention. But the ability to create such content, in particular videos, continues to be costly and challenging to scale. Our ambition is to build technology that equips more people with the power to reach, captivate, and inspire audiences.
Learn more at . Visit our Mission and Culture doc here.

The Role

We are hiring Mid-Market Account Executives to help accelerate adoption of HeyGen across growing mid-sized companies. This is a full-cycle closing role with a heavy emphasis on self-sourced pipeline. You will identify high-potential accounts, run creative outbound campaigns, qualify opportunities, lead discovery, demo the product, build consensus across buying groups, manage deal cycles, and close new business. Mid-market sits between high-velocity commercial selling and traditional enterprise. Deals are larger and involve more stakeholders than a commercial sale, but they still need to move fast. We are looking for closers who can run a structured, multi-stakeholder sales process while keeping the pace, urgency, and creativity of a hunter. You will sell both the HeyGen web app and HeyGen API, helping customers understand how AI video can transform marketing, sales enablement, customer education, training, localization, product onboarding, and developer-powered video workflows.

What You'll Do

Build your own pipeline - You will run high-volume, high-quality outbound into target mid-market accounts. This includes cold email, phone, LinkedIn, personalized video, account research, trigger-based outreach, and creative campaign ideas. You should be excited by the idea of finding your own opportunities, not waiting for perfect inbound leads.

Own the full sales cycle - You will manage opportunities from first touch to close. That includes prospecting, qualification, discovery, product demos, business-case development, security reviews, negotiation, legal/procurement coordination, and handoff to Customer Success.

Run multi-stakeholder deals - Most deals will involve several people: a business champion, an economic buyer, a technical evaluator, and often security or procurement. You will map the buying group early, build consensus, and keep every stakeholder moving toward a decision.

Sell business outcomes, not just AI features - You will help customers understand how HeyGen can reduce video production costs, speed up content creation, improve localization, personalize customer communication, and unlock new video workflows that were not possible before. You will build business cases with a clear return that a budget holder can sign off on.

Sell across web app and API use cases - Some customers will want to use HeyGen directly through the web app. Others may want to integrate HeyGen into their own product, platform, workflow, or internal system using APIs. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be technically curious and comfortable explaining technical concepts in simple business language.

Move fast and create urgency - Mid-market cycles are longer than a commercial deal, but they should never drift. You will keep deals moving, create momentum with busy buyers, ask direct questions, uncover pain, tie pain to business impact, and drive clear next steps.

Partner with PLG, growth, product, and customer teams - You will work with product-led growth signals, self-serve users, product usage data, customer requests, and inbound interest to identify expansion and conversion opportunities. Maintain strong pipeline discipline - You will keep CRM data clean, forecast accurately, manage next steps, and understand the difference between real pipeline and hopeful pipeline.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • 6+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years in a closing role.
  • A track record of meeting or exceeding quota selling into mid-market companies.
  • Experience generating a meaningful portion of your own pipeline through outbound prospecting.
  • Experience running multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including business cases, security reviews, and procurement.
  • Strong discovery skills and the ability to connect product capabilities to business pain.
  • Comfort selling to marketing, sales, customer success, L&D, product, operations, IT, finance, or technical stakeholders.
  • A high-agency, builder mindset. You do not wait for perfect playbooks. You test, learn, and iterate.
  • Strong written communication skills. Your outbound emails, follow-ups, proposals, and deal recaps should be clear, sharp, and persuasive.
  • Curiosity about AI, video, creative workflows, and API-driven products.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience selling PLG, usage-based, API, developer platform, creative software, marketing technology, sales technology, or AI products.
  • Experience selling into marketing, localization, customer education, learning and development, sales enablement, ecommerce, media, or product teams.
  • Experience turning team-level or departmental usage into larger, company-wide contracts.
  • Experience using video, personalization, or creative outbound to source opportunities.
  • Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment.

Who Will Thrive Here

  • Gets energy from prospecting and hunting.
  • Can write a sharp cold email without waiting for marketing to give you a template.
  • Is comfortable making calls, sending videos, testing messaging, and following up persistently.
  • Can keep a deal with five or six stakeholders moving without losing pace.
  • Can take a new product category and figure out where buyers feel urgency.
  • Does not need a fully built sales playbook to be productive.
  • Can sell to both business users and technical evaluators.
  • Is competitive, resourceful, and organized.
  • Knows how to balance speed with thoughtful qualification.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission.
  • Equity in a high-growth AI company.
  • Health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Flexible PTO.
  • Opportunity to help define a new category in AI video.
  • High ownership, high velocity, and direct impact on revenue growth.

jobs.excerpt: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era.  Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it.
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar. The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar. Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not. You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

  • You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad.
  • Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop.
  • 3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't.
  • Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses.
  • Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube.
  • Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure.
  • Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents.
  • You can shoot and cut video yourself.
  • Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography.
  • Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • Colleagues in 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.
  • Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount.
  • Your name on the work: you build your own audience on company time, and we want you to.
  • Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.
  • You will kill a lot of your own output: accurate and lifeless still goes in the bin.
  • Judged on output, not architecture: an elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure.

Hiring Process

  1. 15-minute phone screen - with a founder
  2. Short Assignment
  3. Craft deep dive (90 min)
  4. Culture fit (1 hour)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

jobs.description:
Overview

Quest is an award-winning IT management software provider offering a broad selection of solutions that solve some of the most common and most challenging IT problems. Quest strives to be the best of the very best in everything we do. We are fanatically customer-focused and are proud to support the most complex customers who have the highest IT demands in the world. It’s exciting, it’s rewarding, it’s hard work, and offers career and personal growth.

At Quest Software, we build technology that simplifies IT management and strengthens cybersecurity resilience for organizations around the world. Our people are central to our success, and we are committed to delivering an HR experience that reflects our global footprint, growth mindset, and employee-first culture.

The Opportunity

This isn't a keep-the-lights-on HRIS job. Quest Software is looking for a Sr. HRIS Analyst, based in Panama, to help administer, improve, and reimagine the HR technology behind our global workforce, including Dayforce (HCM/payroll), iCIMS (recruiting), Lattice (performance and compensation), and the connected platforms that power our people processes worldwide.

This team is in motion: while we maintain some systems, we're breaking and rebuilding others. We're looking for someone with the technical strength to do the job well and the curiosity to contribute to the HR tech roadmap: someone who sees change as opportunity. If that's you, please apply, even if you don't check every box!

This is a remote position based in Panama.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

System Administration & Data ManagementSome of this work is steady maintenance but where you make a difference is researching and implementing permanent fixes, not just quick patches, for broken or inefficient configurations.

  • Maintain and administer core HR systems (Dayforce, iCIMS, Lattice, and others), including configuration, security roles, and workflows.
  • Own the accuracy and integrity of HR data through regular audits, validation, and clean-up; good decisions start with good data.
  • Keep configurations, security, workflows, integrations, and day-to-day system health in top shape, and build or update the documentation that keeps everyone aligned.
  • Serve as an escalation point when issues arise, partnering with vendors and IT on root-cause analysis and permanent fixes.

Projects, Implementations & TransformationThis is the part of the job that rewards curiosity and grit. You’ll spot the opportunity for change and help make it happen, alongside a broader HR team doing the same.

  • Lead or support module rollouts, system implementations, enhancements, and vendor or platform changes, from discovery through go-live and hypercare.
  • Coordinate data migration, integration mapping, testing, and cutover as our HR technology roadmap advances.
  • Support the creation of user guides that drive genuine adoption of new tools and ways of working.
  • Configure system changes and coordinate release management, including regression testing and UAT.
  • Help gather requirements so functional specifications are clear from the start.
  • Partner within HRIS and with HR Operations, IT, Finance, and system owners across the Americas, EMEA, and APJ to deliver aligned, scalable solutions.

Data, Reporting & Controls This work turns HR data into something the business can trust and use, with disciplined controls, clean reporting, and the follow-through to fix issues at the source.

  • Protect data integrity through audits, validation, clean-up, and controls across integrated systems.
  • Build or support automated reports and dashboards that meet business needs and let stakeholders self-serve.
  • Support security, compliance, and audit requirements, including SOC and ISO controls.
  • Ensure data readiness for the cycles that matter most, including compensation and performance.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

Consider these a strong foundation, not a rigid gate. If you bring the drive and curiosity, we want to hear from you even if you don't have every item.

  • Experience as an HRIS analyst, technical business systems analyst, or in a comparable systems role (3+ years).
  • Hands-on exposure to enterprise HR platforms such as Dayforce, iCIMS, Lattice, or similar; grit and curiosity outweigh any specific system certification.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with real attention to detail, data accuracy, and confidentiality.
  • Some experience with system implementations, integrations, configuration changes, or vendor transitions.
  • A self-motivated approach; you work independently, prioritize well, follow through, and can carry the steady work as readily as the high-change work.
  • Genuine curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous-learning mindset; you see change as opportunity, not disruption.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Comfort collaborating across time zones with global, distributed teams; clear written and verbal communication in English.
  • Must be located in Panama

Why This Role

This is a rare chance to grow from system caretaker to strategic partner while the roadmap is still being drawn. We won't pretend every day is thrilling, but we can promise your ideas will count and your growth won't stall. If you're driven by curiosity, energized by change, and ready to grow alongside a team doing real transformation, this is your chance!

Company Overview

Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — trust Quest to solve their most critical IT challenges. From securing identities and modernizing platforms to preparing data for AI, we help enterprises unlock their full potential.

Why Quest

At Quest, your work makes an impact. You’ll help organizations get AI-ready while building your career with a global team of innovators. We offer:

  • Competitive pay, annual bonuses, and top-performer recognition.
  • Comprehensive health, family, and retirement benefits.
  • Flexible work options, generous PTO, and wellness programs.
  • Professional growth through learning platforms, mentorship, and leadership programs.
  • Inclusive teams that reflect the world we serve, supported by Employee Resource Groups and our Equality & Inclusion Council.

Quest is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: Quest is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Quest are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Quest will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Quest encourages applicants of all ages.

Come join us. For more information, visit us on the web at Quest Careers | Innovate. Collaborate. Grow.

Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on quest.com/careers using our applicant system. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps like Telegram to communicate with applicants, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way and only interact with people claiming to be Quest employees if they have an email address ending in @quest.com. You can report job scams to the FTC (ReportFraud.ftc.gov) or your state attorney general.

From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

Applicants must have the right to work in the country they are applying from and be able to work without employer sponsorship.

About the Role

As a Senior PHP/Symfony Engineer, you will take hands-on ownership of backend development within a mature Symfony platform that manages marketing and revenue data for enterprise customers. The core application currently runs on Symfony 6.1, with an upgrade to Symfony 7 planned, alongside an Angular front end and TypeScript and Python AI agent microservices.

This is a strongly backend-weighted, senior hands-on engineering role requiring an architect mindset, strong independence and the ability to understand how technical decisions affect the wider system. You will work within a remote, cross-functional product squad alongside engineering, product, QA and DevOps colleagues.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of backend development within the core Symfony application, becoming fully independent in delivering work within 2–3 months of joining.
  • Review and critically assess code written by the team and AI tools, challenging proposed approaches and making sure key considerations have been properly addressed.
  • Support the migration from Symfony 6.1 to Symfony 7 by resolving versioning, compatibility and legacy issues currently preventing the upgrade.
  • Improve the application’s performance, scalability and maintainability, making it easier and safer to introduce new functionality.
  • Work across the Angular front end, TypeScript and Python-based AI agent services, collaborating with DevOps where backend changes impact other areas of the system.
  • Be comfortable reading and understanding the Angular/TypeScript codebase, even though the role is primarily backend focused. Strong front-end development experience is not required.
  • Understand the wider impact of technical decisions across Symfony, Angular and AI services, while spotting gaps or issues in both human-written and AI-generated code.
  • Question existing approaches, identify root causes and look for better ways of building things rather than simply completing assigned tickets.
  • Deliver thoughtful, maintainable solutions within a legacy codebase while maintaining a consistent pace of delivery.
  • Work with a high level of autonomy and ownership while collaborating effectively with a remote, cross-functional team.
  • Follow SOC 2, PII and security requirements consistently and without exception.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of commercial software engineering experience, including at least 5 years working with PHP.
  • 7+ years of Expert-level PHP development experience.
  • 3+ years of recent commercial experience with Symfony 6.x/7 at Advanced level. Strong senior-level Laravel experience may be considered where the experience is clearly transferable and the candidate has a good understanding of the differences between Laravel and Symfony.
  • 4+ years of Advanced experience in backend architecture, system design and scalability.
  • 2+ years of Advanced experience using AI development tools critically, including reviewing, validating and challenging AI-generated code rather than accepting it without question.
  • 5+ years of Advanced MySQL experience, including database schema design and query optimisation. Equivalent depth of experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database may also be considered.
  • At least 1 year of experience working with or understanding Angular/TypeScript. Experience with React or Vue using TypeScript may also be considered, but some front-end exposure is essential.
  • 3+ years of Advanced experience with automated testing using PHPUnit. Experience with Pest or another equivalent PHP testing framework may also be considered.
  • At least 1 year of Intermediate experience working on framework upgrades and modernising legacy codebases. Experience with major-version upgrades or significant refactoring in other large PHP applications may be considered.
  • 2+ years of Intermediate AWS experience. Equivalent experience with Azure or GCP may also be considered.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote environment.
  • Ability to work UK hours.
  • Ability to successfully complete strict background checks and adhere to PII and data protection requirements.
  • Strong self-sufficiency, with the ability to operate independently and without handholding after 2–3 months, while continuing to collaborate effectively with the wider team.
  • A hands-on engineering approach combined with an architectural mindset, with the ability to understand how and why the wider system works rather than focusing only on writing code.

Nice to Have

  • 2+ years of Intermediate CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions; GitLab CI, Jenkins or Azure DevOps are suitable alternatives.
  • Basic experience with Amazon Redshift or data warehousing; Snowflake or BigQuery may be considered.
  • Azure exposure alongside AWS.
  • Previous project leadership experience.
  • Previous mentoring and technical leadership experience with other engineers.

The Company
At Spartan Investment Group our mission is to improve lives through our values. We do this by finding value-add and opportunistic investments offering solid returns to our investors. Providing an opportunity to grow for our partners and creating lasting wealth for everyone with whom we conduct business is how we make our greatest contribution. 
We specifically focus on self-storage projects capitalizing on amazing deals in other asset classes. In 2021, we were listed as the 5th fastest growing real estate company in the US and joined the list of the top 100 owners of self-storage. We are members of the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America and in 2023 we were #13 in Denver Business Journals list of top places to work.

Mission

The mission of the Director of Customer Experience is to own and continuously improve the end-to-end customer experience across FreeUp Storage, creating a consistent journey that strengthens customer satisfaction, conversion, and retention. Working at the intersection of Customer Care, Operations, and Marketing, this role connects customer insights, field execution, and brand strategy to drive FUS operational excellence. This will be a remote position.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Customer Care/StoreEase Team Performance: Lead the StoreEase Customer Care team to consistently meet established service and performance expectations, including the 20-second phone greet goal, while contributing to broader FUS goals for conversion, autopay enrollment, customer protection, satisfaction, and retention.

  • Google Reviews & Customer Reputation: Drive the customer review and response process across FreeUp Storage, supporting an average Google rating of 4.7+ stars and ensuring customer reviews receive timely, professional responses. Use review trends and feedback to identify opportunities to improve the customer experience.

  • Call & Property Audits: Own the customer experience quality assurance program, maintaining 100% completion of scheduled call and property audits. Ensure findings are translated into coaching, process improvements, and appropriate operational follow-up.

  • Third-Party Customer Service Business Plan: Develop and present a comprehensive third-party Customer Care business plan within the first 90 days, including the service model, staffing, technology, pricing, financial considerations, and implementation plan, and lead execution against approved milestones.

Outcomes

  • Customer Journey & Experience: Own and continuously improve the end-to-end FreeUp Storage customer journey, from initial inquiry through rental and ongoing tenancy. Identify friction points and lead improvements that create a seamless, consistent customer experience.

  • Customer Satisfaction & Retention: Strengthen customer satisfaction and retention by identifying recurring pain points, improving issue resolution, and ensuring customer needs are reflected in service and operational improvements.

  • Customer Experience Standards: Define and maintain clear customer experience standards across key touchpoints, creating consistency between the FUS brand, Customer Care interactions, and the experience delivered at the property level.

  • Customer Insights & Continuous Improvement: Bring together customer feedback, reviews, audits, performance data, and other customer insights to identify trends and root causes. Translate findings into clear priorities and measurable improvements across the business.

  • Customer Experience Processes & Scalability: Develop and continuously improve customer-facing processes, SOPs, escalation paths, and handoffs to create an efficient and consistent experience that can scale with portfolio growth.

  • Cross-Functional Customer Experience Alignment: Create alignment across Customer Care, Operations, and Marketing around the customer journey, ensuring customer needs and insights inform how FUS attracts, serves, and retains customers.

Competencies

Customer Experience Focus – Understands the complete customer journey and identifies opportunities to improve satisfaction, loyalty, and the overall experience across customer touchpoints.

Leadership & People Development – Builds high-performing teams through clear expectations, coaching, accountability, feedback, and development.

Operational Excellence – Connects customer experience to day-to-day operations and develops scalable standards and processes that improve quality, consistency, and efficiency.

Data-Driven Decision Making – Uses customer feedback and performance data to identify trends, determine root causes, prioritize opportunities, and measure results.

Strategic & Business Acumen – Connects customer experience initiatives to broader operational, marketing, growth, and financial objectives and translates strategy into execution.

Cross-Functional Collaboration – Builds alignment and influences across teams to ensure shared priorities result in a consistent customer experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Operations, or a related field required.

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in customer service, customer experience, operations, or a related field, including 4+ years leading customer-facing teams.

  • Experience owning customer service performance, quality standards, and process improvement across a multi-location or growing organization.

  • Experience with third-party or outsourced customer service operations, vendor management, or developing new service offerings preferred.

  • Self-storage, property management, multi-site operations, or other distributed consumer service experience preferred.

  • Experience with StoreEase, CallPotential, Lead Management Systems (LMS), XPS Solutions, or comparable customer service platforms preferred.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Access to company carried interest program.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

The Technical Sales & Application Manager for Power System Protection & Control is responsible for driving revenue growth, market penetration, and customer engagement through a combination of deep technical expertise and commercial leadership. This role bridges application engineering, technical sales, and market development, supporting Electric Utility customers with advanced protection, control, and power quality solutions.

The position requires strong knowledge of power system protection, controls, and grid automation technologies, combined with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable sales strategies, product improvements, and application solutions.

#remote

A Day In The Life

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Sales Leadership

• Lead technical sales efforts for protection, control, and power quality solutions across assigned territory.
• Develop and execute territory specific sales strategies to achieve revenue and growth targets.
• Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and technical seminars to customers and channel partners.
• Support complex sales cycles by providing application expertise and solution positioning.
2. Sales Execution & Pipeline Management
• Own territory execution includes planning, forecasting, and performance tracking
• Support quotation activities and ensure solutions align with customer specifications.
• Drive sales through differentiated applications and technical value propositions.
• Maintain disciplined CRM practices including opportunity tracking, activity logging, and account planning.
• Manage customer accounts, territories, agents, channel partners or strategic customers.
• Establish consistent customer engagement cadence including site visits, technical discussions, and follow-ups with clear action plan and next steps
3. Application Engineering & Customer Support
• Serve as the primary technical advisor to customers on system design, product selection, application requirements, protection & control schemes, automation strategies, and grid modernization initiatives.
• Support troubleshooting, installation, and integration of protection and control systems.
• Serve as escalation point for customer issues, ensuring timely resolution through internal coordination
• Develop application notes, technical documentation, and customer training materials.
4. Market Development & Business Growth
• Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities.
• Build and maintain relationships with utilities, EPCs, consultants, and key stakeholders.
• Expand presence in key segments such as electric power distribution, generation, substations & distribution automation.
• Drive adoption of emerging technologies (e.g., digital substations, IEC 61850, grid analytics).
5. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner closely with Business Development, Product Management, Engineering, Customer Technical Services, and applicable HUS sales teams to:
o Translate customer needs into product enhancements
o Support new product development and validation
o Provide “Voice of the Customer” feedback
o Support pilot programs, trials, product evaluations, and customer validation processes
• Collaborate with internal teams on pricing strategies, proposals, and technical solutions

What will help you thrive in this role?

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • BSEE or an equivalent experience; MSEE or MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 3-10 years in power systems, with emphasis on protection & control applications, technical sales, or application engineering.
  • Experience working with:
    • Transformer Tap Changer, Voltage Regulator, and Capacitor Controls. Recloser controls, Protective Relays, PQ meters and automation systems
    • Working with Electric Utility Power Systems
    • Customer-facing roles (sales, consulting, or applications)

Technical Competencies

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Power system protection principles (Distribution/Generation and Substation)
    • Control systems and automation (e.g., FLISR, Volt/VAR)
    • Industry standards (IEEE, IEC) and protocols (DNP3, MODBUS, IEC 61850)
  • Ability to interpret electrical specifications, drawings, and system studies.

Leadership & Commercial Skills

  • Strong communication and presentation skills with customer-facing confidence
  • Ability to influence technical and commercial decisions
  • Experience managing accounts, territories, agents, channel partners or strategic customers
  • Proven ability to balance technical depth with business objectives

Key Success Factors

  • Ability to integrate technical application knowledge with sales strategy
  • Strong customer focus and relationship-building capability
  • Market awareness, responsiveness to industry trends, and commitment to continuous learning in evolving power system standards
  • Collaboration across engineering, product management, and sales teams
  • Drive for results aligned with growth targets and business objectives

Travel

  • 50% to 70% of travel to customer sites, offices, field visits, training, conferences, seminars, and in-person meetings as required.

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

AlphaGov (Casa Moon LLC d/b/a AlphaGov) delivers public-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

We engage experienced practitioners as project-based collaborators. Engagements are remote-first with occasional client travel. When you authorize it, AlphaGov may name you as an expert collaborator or key personnel on proposals that match your expertise. AlphaGov is seeking a Classification & Compensation Analyst to support an active municipal classification and compensation study (City of Myrtle Beach, SC — proposal due early October 2026).

Named-SME-with-resume role. Candidate evidence deadline 10/01/2026. Consent: Yes = may be named on proposals; Ask first = do not name until Chris confirms; No = never named.

Requirements

Required:

  • Classification and compensation analysis experience
  • Salary-survey methods experience

  • Comfortable as a 1099 / project-based collaborator with travel as needed for client on-sites

Nice to have:

  • Public-sector compensation study experience
  • Job evaluation methodology (point factor, market pricing, or comparable)
  • South Carolina local-government familiarity

jobs.excerpt: Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team Financial Analyst, Travel Supplier Strategy (Remote) Full time, United States The Financial Analyst, Travel Supplier Strategy provides analytical, operational, and strategic support across defined supplier functions (Air/Car/Hotel).
jobs.description:
Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team

Financial Analyst, Travel Supplier Strategy (Remote)

Full time, United States

The Financial Analyst, Travel Supplier Strategy provides analytical, operational, and strategic support across defined supplier functions (Air/Car/Hotel). This role delivers data-driven analysis that identifies revenue opportunities, and highlights potential business risks to support suppliers and organizational objectives.

The position focuses on evaluating suppliers’ financial performance, conducting financial and operational analysis, and transforming complex data into actionable insights that drive decision-making. By identifying patterns, measuring business impact, and developing meaningful reporting and performance metrics, the Analyst supports supplier strategies that enhance supplier value and business results.

As a Financial Analyst, Travel Supplier Strategy, you will

  • Analyze supplier revenue, commission, incentive, and performance data to identify trends, validate results, and generate insights that support forecasting, budgeting, business reviews, and strategic decision-making
  • Develop and maintain financial models that support supplier negotiations, business case development, forecasting, and strategic planning activities
  • Partner with supplier managers and leadership teams to evaluate proposed agreements and quantify the projected financial and operational impact of contractual changes
  • Support annual planning, forecasting, and budgeting processes through data-driven analysis and financial performance assessments
  • Leverage existing reporting tools and Microsoft Office applications to analyze data against contract models and assess strategic options
  • Conduct analysis on ad hoc suppliers, evaluating their potential impact on performance and revenue
  • Use supplier, internal, and 3rd-party data to develop interactive reporting that tracks supplier contractual and financial performance, ensuring optimal revenues and earnings rates
  • Communicate the analyses in an effective manner with internal teams and illustrate recommended levers to act upon analytical findings
  • Drive continuous improvement of reporting capabilities by identifying gaps, recommending enhancements, and partnering on the development of new analytical tools and solutions
  • Develop an expert level understanding of supplier data to ensure accuracy and integrity of reported results

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Prior analytical and financial experience, especially in the travel industry
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and provide actionable insights
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools like Excel
  • Effective communication skills (oral, written & presentation) in English
  • Basic SQL knowledge is a plus

What we offer you

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

At BCD Travel we value you, our culture and success is defined by you. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your professional background and experience. The salary range for candidates in applicable jurisdictions in the US for the position of Financial Analyst, Travel Supplier Strategy is between $65,000 and $76,000. The actual pay depends on your skills, qualifications, experience and geographical location.

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at .
