jobs.title: Revenue Manager Camping H/F
jobs.excerpt: Dans le cadre de sa croissance, Septeo Revenue Pilot (E-Axess), intégré au pôle Septeo Solutions Hospitality, recherche un Revenue Manager H/F en CDI (France Entière), spécialisé(e) dans le camping.
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de sa croissance, Septeo Revenue Pilot (E-Axess), intégré au pôle Septeo Solutions Hospitality, recherche un Revenue Manager H/F en CDI (France Entière), spécialisé(e) dans le camping.

En tant que Revenue Manager Camping, vous prenez en charge progressivement un portefeuille pouvant atteindre une quinzaine de campings.

Véritable partenaire de vos clients, vous analysez leurs performances, identifiez les opportunités et transformez les données en recommandations concrètes et argumentées.

Votre quotidien :

  • Piloter et développer la performance d'un portefeuille de campings,
  • Définir, construire et ajuster les stratégies tarifaires en fonction de la saisonnalité, du rythme des ventes, du remplissage et du positionnement concurrentiel.
  • Analyser les principaux indicateurs de performance.
  • Construire les grilles tarifaires et réaliser les bilans de saison, puis accompagner les établissements tout au long de leur cycle de vente
  • Formuler des recommandations tarifaires et opérationnelles et, selon les outils et les configurations des clients, participer directement à leur mise en œuvre.
  • Assurer une veille concurrentielle.
  • Conseiller et accompagner vos clients dans leurs prises de décision en leur présentant vos analyses et en expliquant de manière claire et pédagogique les stratégies recommandées.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Marketing

Vous avez une première expérience en Revenue Management, acquise dans l'hôtellerie de plein air ou un environnement comparable.

Vous êtes :

  • à l'aise avec les chiffres, l'analyse et les indicateurs de performance ;
  • capable de construire et défendre une stratégie tarifaire ;
  • doté(e) d'un très bon relationnel client ;
  • à l'aise à l'oral et capable de vulgariser vos analyses avec pédagogie ;
  • autonome dans l'organisation et le suivi de votre portefeuille ;
  • sensible aux problématiques de distribution, de saisonnalité et de veille concurrentielle.

Une connaissance ou une première utilisation de PMS et d'outils liés au Revenue Management sera appréciée. Une expérience sur un PMS SEPTEO constitue un plus.

Rejoindre Septeo, c’est aussi :

  • Grandir et s’épanouir grâce à un parcours de formation personnalisé, des opportunités de mobilité interne.
  • Vivre une aventure humaine, échanger et partager autour d’évènements thématisés (afterworks, sport, RSE, séminaires, etc.) 🎉
  • Rejoindre un collectif qui prend soin des autres et s’engage en faveur de l’égalité des chances, la diversité et l’inclusion

Un process de recrutement en 2 étapes :

  1. Un premier échange téléphonique avec un(e) chargé(e) de recrutement pour vous présenter le poste et ses missions, en savoir plus sur vous, vous présenter notre groupe et ses valeurs, mais aussi connaitre vos motivations et l'adéquation de votre projet professionnel avec le poste proposé.
  2. Un second entretien avec votre binôme RM; double objectif : faire un focus métier et valider l’ensemble de vos compétences.

Vous faites quoi lundi ?

Septeo est un acteur de référence du software en Europe, présent à l’international et reconnu parmi le top 5 des éditeurs de logiciels sectoriels en France. En forte croissance et en transformation permanente, le groupe s’impose comme un acteur clé de l’édition logicielle grâce à la force de son collectif : des équipes déterminées, audacieuses et engagées.

Chez Septeo, l’intelligence artificielle est placée au cœur de notre évolution. Nous la concevons comme un levier de performance durable, de collaboration et d’innovation, intégrée de manière responsable dans les pratiques du quotidien et démocratisé sur l’ensemble de nos métiers. L'ambition est claire : “make intelligent software for Europe”.

Notre culture repose sur des valeurs fortes : être, faire et transformer ensemble. Elle n’est pas figée ; elle se vit chaque jour dans nos actions et nos décisions, à travers un équilibre entre performance, responsabilité et plaisir.

Cette ambition s’incarne dans ce que nous faisons au quotidien : concevoir des logiciels qui accompagnent les moments de vie essentiels, au service de millions de citoyens. Être présent derrière ces instants clés est une responsabilité forte. C’est la nôtre. Et peut-être bientôt la vôtre.

Rejoindre Septeo, c’est intégrer une aventure collective à dimension internationale, porter la transformation du groupe dans un environnement en mouvement rapide, et faire de l’IA un levier concret de création de valeur, aujourd’hui comme demain.

Prêt(e) à faire partie de l’aventure ?

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.excerpt: JoinphData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India.
jobs.description:
JoinphData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

  • Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
  • AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
  • 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
  • 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
  • 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
  • Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
  • #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
  • 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
  • Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, business-connected People Partner to join our People team and support People Managers and client leadership teams across phData’s US business.

In this role, you will help leaders understand how People practices influence client delivery, team performance, capability, and retention. You will coach and advise leaders on employee relations, performance, talent, organizational change, manager effectiveness, and AI-enabled ways of working.

You will develop a working understanding of the teams you support, including their practices, client engagements, staffing relationships, and functional groups, and translate People strategy into practical manager actions. You will help leaders address issues early, identify patterns in leadership, capability, workload, staffing, and organizational design, and determine when additional expertise is needed.

You will work closely with the VP of Talent Development and cross-functional partners to help client leadership teams navigate these priorities with sound judgment and consistent follow-through.

What You’ll Do

Partner with Client Leadership Teams and Managers

  • Build trusted relationships with client leadership teams, practice and delivery leaders, and People Managers. Learn their priorities, team structures, client-delivery realities, and opportunities to help their teams thrive.
  • Coach and advise leaders on feedback, performance, development, team dynamics, role clarity, workload, retention, and other People matters.
  • Help managers determine the right support for each situation, whether coaching, development, performance support, conduct guidance, or a formal process.
  • Prepare managers for clear, timely, and constructive conversations. Offer thoughtful perspective while connecting People recommendations to delivery effectiveness, leadership capability, employee experience, and retention.

Handle Employee Relations Matters

  • Manage a range of US employee-relations matters, including multi-state situations, with appropriate documentation and confidentiality. Seek guidance when a matter would benefit from additional expertise.
  • Gather facts, assess situations objectively, consider relevant risks and perspectives, recommend practical next steps, and help managers follow through consistently.
  • Partner with client leadership teams, People Operations, Legal, and the VP of Talent Development when matters involve broader legal, policy, precedent, executive, or organizational considerations.

Strengthen Performance, Talent, and Development

  • Embed performance management, feedback, talent assessment, compensation, engagement, and development practices into the regular operating rhythm of supported teams.
  • Help client leadership teams and People Managers set clear expectations, establish useful feedback habits, and support performance and growth processes.
  • Maintain a working view of talent, including performance, development needs, retention signals, and capability needs. Use manager insight and people data to surface themes for talent reviews, calibration, and workforce planning.
  • Partner with Talent Development and Learning & Development to connect client leadership priorities with practical development actions and career growth.

Support Organizational Effectiveness and Change

  • Translate organizational-design, transformation, and talent priorities into clear actions for client leadership teams, People Managers, and employees.
  • Support changes involving role clarity, team structure, leadership transitions, processes, and ways of working.
  • Identify root causes, recommend practical interventions, and coordinate assigned workstreams, communications, follow-through, and adoption with cross-functional stakeholders.

Partner Across the People Team

  • Develop visibility into People themes across client engagements, leadership teams, and functional groups, including manager effectiveness, feedback quality, workload, staffing changes, performance trends, and talent priorities.
  • Work with client leadership teams, Staffing, and delivery leaders to understand how assignments, transitions, and team changes affect employee experience and performance.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional People and business partners so managers receive connected, easy-to-navigate support.
  • Contribute to manager tools, playbooks, operating rhythms, and process improvements.

How You’ll Know You’re Successful

  • Managers address feedback, performance, and employee-relations matters earlier and with greater clarity. Client leadership teams receive practical guidance grounded in business realities and sound People judgment.
  • Performance, talent, compensation, engagement, and change practices are adopted consistently across supported teams, giving leaders clearer visibility into talent priorities, capability needs, retention patterns, and organizational opportunities.
  • You use approved AI tools to synthesize information, develop options, prepare leaders, and create practical materials. You validate outputs, protect confidential information, and apply human judgment to ensure the result is accurate, useful, and appropriate for its audience.
  • Cross-functional People support is coordinated, responsive, and easy for managers to navigate.

About You

  • You are a trusted partner to managers who can think alongside them, translate People practices into practical action, and support consistent follow-through.
  • You combine empathy with candor and help managers build on strengths while addressing opportunities for growth.
  • You are curious about how client leadership teams operate, serve clients, build capability, and make decisions about people and work.
  • You exercise sound judgment when information is incomplete or stakeholder perspectives conflict, and you know when to seek guidance.
  • You can move between strategic context and practical execution, build credibility through thoughtful communication and follow-through, and use AI to improve decisions and deliver more value to the business.

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • Five or more years of progressive experience in Human Resources, People Business Partnering, HR generalist work, Employee Relations, Talent, or a related discipline. Experience in consulting, professional services, technology, or another client-delivery environment is preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Hands-on experience advising US client leadership teams and People Managers on employee relations, performance, feedback, development, and sensitive conversations.
  • Working knowledge of US employment practices, along with the judgment to identify when Legal, People Operations, or senior People leadership should be involved.
  • Experience embedding People programs, such as performance management, engagement, talent assessment, compensation, or development, into day-to-day business practices.
  • Experience supporting organizational change, organizational effectiveness, role and team design, or a distributed, matrixed, or project-based organization.
  • Ability to use people data and qualitative insight to identify patterns and opportunities.

Skills and Capabilities

  • Strong manager-coaching and business-partnering skills, including the ability to offer thoughtful perspective and create productive challenge.
  • Strong employee-relations judgment, investigation, documentation, and situation-assessment skills.
  • Clear communication, facilitation, influencing, relationship-building, and cross-functional project-execution skills.
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI tools in daily work to analyze information, create practical solutions, prepare communications, and improve workflows, with sound judgment about accuracy, bias, confidentiality, privacy, and human review.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting a technology-focused consulting or professional-services business and partnering with Staffing, resource management, delivery, or practice leadership teams.
  • Experience supporting talent reviews, career frameworks, manager capability, leadership development, or teams across multiple US states.

Our Approach

At phData, People Partners help leaders build teams where people can do their best work, grow their capabilities, and choose to stay. Effective partnership combines business understanding, practical coaching, sound judgment, responsible use of AI, and consistent follow-through.

phData celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at phData. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at People Operations.

jobs.excerpt: At Ellis Porter, our goal is to improve the immigration experience for employers and individuals so they can thrive in a smaller world.
jobs.description:
At Ellis Porter, our goal is to improve the immigration experience for employers and individuals so they can thrive in a smaller world. To do this, we've built a team of dedicated immigration professionals (we call ourselves Porters) who believe passionately in the economic and cultural benefits that immigration provides to America, and who excel at providing our clients with refreshingly clear guidance, uniquely creative strategies,and remarkably responsive service, all withgenuine empathy anda personal touch.

Immigration law is very complex and full of constant challenges, but the Ellis Porter team loves what we do, and who we do it with, and we find great satisfaction in knowing that our work positively, and intimately, impacts our clients’ lives.

Our Culture:

We're also immensely proud of (and protective of) our culture at Ellis Porter. It's not what you would expect from a typical law firm, because we're not a typical law firm. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We don't tolerate drama, and jerks are not allowed. And we’ve built a wonderfully diverse team of Porters who reflect the diversity of the clients we serve.

As our team continues to grow, we’ve remained committed to cultivating an inspiring, authentic, comfortable, and flexible work environment where you are respected, encouraged to bring your whole self to work, and challenged to continue your growth as a professional in the legal immigration field.

The Position:

As an Immigration Attorney on our High-Skilled Immigration team, you will be part of a team of attorneys and case managers that help our clients navigate immigrant work visa issues. You will work with clients in a variety of industries, including technology, engineering, bioscience, and other emerging industries, to help them seize exciting opportunities in today’s evolving economy - it's truly rewarding work.

This position can be fully remote from any U.S. location, or based in either our Troy, MI or Ann Arbor, MI office as an in-person or hybrid role. Please note - although this role can be remote, all work must be performed within the United States.

What You'll Do:

  • Under the direction of the High-Skilled Immigration Partner and Senior Attorneys, you'll work with clients to develop and implement legal strategies for work visa matters, including EB-1A, EB-1B, EB-2 NIW, and O-1 petitions.
  • Conduct in-depth conversations with clients and prospective clients to explain immigration processes and coordinate with clients to gather detailed supporting information and evidence.
  • Answer questions about their immigration process steps, timelines and costs.
  • Prepare and file immigration petitions with USCIS, in collaboration with fellow Attorneys and Case Managers (paralegals).
  • Prepare responses to Requests for Evidence issued by USCIS.

What Skills and Experience You'll Bring:

  • 1-3+ years of experience in U.S. immigration matters.
  • Possess a Juris Doctor degree & are a member of any US State Bar.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a busy caseload in an efficient manner and consistent with numerous inflexible legal deadlines.
  • Ability to collaborate professionally and effectively with team members.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to break down complex legal concepts into language that is easy for clients to understand.
  • Patience to conduct frequent, and sometimes somewhat repetitive, educational correspondence and/or calls with clients and potential clients summarizing their application processes and answering their questions.
  • Comfort using advanced digital tools and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, conduct research, and enhance client communication efficiency.
  • High level of attention to detail, emotional intelligence, and empathy.
  • Take pride in delivering highly responsive and proactive client service.

What We'll Provide to You:

  • An opportunity to do challenging and highly rewarding work at a fast-growing firm with an inspiring mission.
  • An opportunity to join intelligent, creative, and dedicated immigration professionals who value respectful, collaborative working relationships.
  • Inclusive firm culture celebrating diverse perspectives, backgrounds, identities, and experiences.
  • People-centered workplace policies and flexible work schedules, including remote work opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation, health/dental/vision/life insurance benefits, a 401(k)-retirement savings plan with employer-matching, and a generous paid-time-off policy.
  • Casual attire and lots of free food and regular opportunities for exposure to international cuisine and culture.

Does this position, and our culture, seem like a good fit for you? If so, we would love to speak with you about joining the Ellis Porter team!

Our development focuses on state-of-the-art soft-body physics vehicle simulation, currently available as an early access videogame - BeamNG.drive, and as a stand-alone research platform -

We are looking for a Senior Marketing, PR & Communications Specialist to join our Communications & Marketing team. You will help shape how BeamNG communicates with players, media, creators, partners, and the wider gaming community, while working closely with a diverse team of specialists across multiple channels and regions.

Responsibilities

  • Own integrated marketing, PR, and communications campaigns across organic, paid, earned, owned, and partner channels
  • Develop compelling messaging and campaign narratives for product updates, announcements, newsletters, storefronts, landing pages, social media, and community platforms
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with relevant media outlets, journalists, creators, influencers, platform partners, and community stakeholders
  • Plan and execute impactful initiatives that grow our audience, strengthen community engagement, and amplify major BeamNG beats
  • Coordinate content production for promotional materials, ensuring assets are creative, high-quality, on-brand, and aligned with marketing objectives

  • Excellent understanding of videogame marketing, games media, creator ecosystems, player communities, and digital audience development
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; additional languages are a plus
  • Proven experience planning and leading organic, paid, PR, influencer, or creator campaigns across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Meta, YouTube, Discord, Steam, and related channels
  • Strong PR skills, including media outreach, pitching, press materials, interview coordination, review programs, and coverage tracking
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful player-centric campaigns, creative promotions, PR initiatives, content strategies, or community activations
  • Practical knowledge of content creation tools and software such as in-game capture, DaVinci Resolve, OBS, Figma, Adobe Suite, or similar tools

Nice to have

  • Passion for videogames and interest in automotive culture, simulation, motorsport, or vehicle-based games
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision in a fully remote, international environment
  • Previous experience working with an indie game development studio, publisher, PR agency, platform, or creator-focused organization
  • Experience mentoring, coordinating, or leading marketing, PR, communications, community, or content contributors
  • Familiarity with gaming platforms and workflows such as Steam, Epic Games Store, Discord, forums, newsletters, press kits, and storefront communications

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Language courses
  • Talent development program (training budget, participation in seminars/conferences, and etc)
  • Personal development program (feedback, leadership, conflict engagement, etc)
  • Budget for home office
  • Parental leave
  • Employee assistance program
  • Relocation assistance (if applicable)

Our recruitment process

Our recruitment process starts with an introductory call with our HR team, continues a technical interview, and finally a stakeholder interview

About us

Our journey began in 2013 and we've continued to expand as an independent studio since then. We are a team of over 90 employees of 29 nationalities with a headquarters in Bremen, Germany, and we are always on the lookout for expert talent to join us!

We consider our employees to be our most valuable assets, and all of them play a vital role in helping us establish and nurture the company's culture and values. We are a guild of innovators, artists, engineers, and designers, who appreciate and embrace the diversity of our perspectives and know-how to apply them to grow together as a community and foster a healthy work environment.

Together, we are building a safe and inclusive atmosphere, with transparent processes to amplify individuality, empathy, respect, creativity, and continuous learning for all employees. Regardless of your identity or background, we would be happy to welcome your application if you feel inspired and want to become a part of our team! Skip writing lengthy cover letters and tell us more about your passion for gaming and why specifically BeamNG. Do not be discouraged if you don’t meet all the criteria for a specific role, feel free to submit an unsolicited application.

To minimize bias throughout the hiring process, please submit your application in English.

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. For more information, visit JadeBiosciences.com and follow the Company on LinkedIn.

Role Overview

The Sr/Clinical Trial Manager will support the Director, Clinical Operations, who is the cross functional clinical trial leader, in the planning and operational execution of assigned clinical trials. This individual will coordinate day-to-day study activities across cross-functional partners, clinical sites, CROs, and other vendors; maintain study plans, timelines, budgets, risks, and key documentation; and escalate issues with clear recommendations. The Senior/Clinical Trial Manager will serve as a primary operational contact for assigned responsibilities, vendors, and regions and help ensure trials are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practice, and company standards.  With a proventrack record of clinical trial management, financial acumen, and problem-solving skills, this individual will thrive in Jade’s dynamic environment.This is an exciting opportunity to make significant contributions to Jade’s immunology pipeline, managing trials from first in human single site to global (APAC, LATAM, etc.) phase 3.

  • Maintain clinical trial budgets and forecasts; review invoices, track committed and actual spend, identify variances, and escalate financial risks to the Director 
  • Maintain study risk, issue, decision, and action logs; drives mitigation and resolution activities and promptly escalates material risks with recommended options 
  • Coordinate operational input into the development, review, and implementation of clinical documents, including protocols, monitoring plans, informed consent forms, investigator brochures, pharmacy and laboratory manuals, and clinical study reports 
  • Oversee global or regional study start-up, site activation, enrollment, conduct, monitoring, closeout, and inspection-readiness activities for assigned trials 
  • Support planning and conducting investigator meetings in alignment with Director guidance
  • Responsible for monitoring oversight, inclusive of study specific templates and plans, reviewing monitoring reports for compliance to study protocols, regulations and ICF/GCP, tracking and managing monitoring report metrics.
  • Build effective working relationships with clinical sites, investigators, CROs, vendors, and internal stakeholders and serves as a key operational point of contact 
  • Review study performance metrics and operational data, identifies trends or gaps, and implements corrective and preventive actions in partnership with the Director and cross-functional team 
  • Ensure clinical trial activities and documentation comply with the protocol, Good Clinical Practice, applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and company procedures 
  • Support clinical supply, central laboratory, data management, safety, biostatistics, medical monitoring, and regulatory activities by coordinating operational requirements and timelines 
  • Oversee the maintenance of a complete, accurate, and inspection-ready Trial Master File documentation and supports audits, inspections, and quality oversight activities 
  • Mentor Clinical Trial Associates and Clinical Trial Managers; contributes to Clinical Operations process improvements, and prepare clear study updates for governance and senior leadership 

Qualifications

  • Bachelors and10+ years of related experience for Sr Clinical Trial Manager and 7+ years of related experience for the Clinical Trial Manager
  • Trial management within a biopharmaceutical company; experience at a small startup is a plus.Demonstrated ability to manage complex clinical trial activities, timelines, vendors, budgets, risks, and cross-functional deliverables with appropriate independence and escalation 
  • Experience supporting Phase 1 through Phase 3 clinical trials; global clinical trial experience is preferred 
  • Immunology and/or rare disease clinical trial experience is preferred 
  • Experience managing CROs and clinical vendors, including laboratories, RTSM, EDC, and ancillary clinical technology or applications 
  • Strong working knowledge of FDA regulations, ICH guidelines, Good Clinical Practice, medical terminology, and clinical trial conduct 
  • Working knowledge of clinical protocol implementation, regulatory submissions, Trial Master File requirements, and the overall drug development process 
  • Experience mentoring or providing day-to-day guidance to junior team members is preferred 
  • Excellent communication, organization, collaboration, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities 

Position Location

This is a remote role; periodic travel to team and company events is required.

We Could Use Someone Like You in Our Crew.

Solutions Engineer

You've moved past following the playbook. Now you write it.

About ModSquad

ModSquad’s Solutions Engineering team works at the leading edge of what CX, AI, and workflow technology can do for the world's best companies. We implement, integrate, and build — turning platform capabilities and agentic AI into real operational outcomes for clients across industries. We're growing, and we're looking for people who want to build with us.

The Job

As a Solutions Engineer, you lead implementation engagements end-to-end. You know the platforms well enough to configure them confidently, understand systems deeply enough to integrate them cleanly, and have the AI instincts to know when — and how — to introduce intelligence into a workflow. You work directly with clients, owning the technical relationship from discovery through delivery and beyond.

This is not a support role or a coordination role. You're building real things for real clients and owning the result.

What You'll Do

  • Lead client engagements from discovery through delivery — owning the technical implementation, the client relationship, and the outcome.

  • Design and build solutions across the partner ecosystem (Zendesk, Zoom CX, Workato, Observe.ai, and others), including configurations, integrations, and AI-powered workflows.

  • Translate client needs into technical specifications — working with Specialists on execution and engaging Architects on complex design challenges.

  • Build and deploy AI-powered workflows, including agentic automations that reduce manual effort and improve client operations.

  • Document what you build — implementation guides, integration specs, workflow diagrams — so clients operate confidently and the team can build on your work.

  • Manage issues and escalations with a systems mindset: fix the immediate problem and close the door so it doesn't come back.

  • Support pre-sales conversations when your technical perspective adds value.


Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience implementing and administering SaaS platforms in client-facing roles — you've owned implementations, not just supported them.

  • Hands-on experience with CX platforms (Zendesk, Zoom Contact Center, or similar) and workflow automation tools (Workato, Zapier, Make, or similar).

  • Working knowledge of APIs, JSON, and systems integration — you understand how platforms talk to each other and why they sometimes don't.

  • Real experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows, with solid instincts for what agentic AI can realistically do inside a business process.

  • Strong client communication skills — you can run a technical working session, manage expectations under pressure, and explain a complex solution clearly to a non-technical audience.

  • Documentation habits that make the next person's job easier, not harder.

  • A systems thinker who solves for root causes, not just immediate symptoms.

  • The MacGyver instinct — you figure things out even when the answer isn't in the documentation.

  • High EQ, personal accountability, and a sense of humor.


Ready to Join?

We're building something real, and we want people who want to build with us. If you're a technical practitioner ready to lead — hit apply and let's talk.

Overview

One Identity's OneLogin team is seeking Staff Software Engineers who operate with high ownership, strong technical judgment, and a bias for action. These roles are designed for engineers who identify and solve problems proactively — not just execute assigned work.

Senior Engineers at OneLogin are expected to operate as T-shaped engineers: deep in a primary domain while remaining capable across the stack (backend, APIs, cloud, and operations). You will play a key role in maintaining product velocity, improving system reliability, and reducing operational burden.

This is a hands-on role that includes on-call responsibilities and requires a strong commitment to modern engineering practices, including AI-augmented development. We are looking for engineers who take full ownership — design, build, test, deploy, and operate — rather than handing work off between silos.

In this role, you will execute and evolve an incremental modernization strategy (e.g., strangler fig), safely transitioning legacy systems into scalable services while maintaining reliability and system continuity.

Responsibilities

Execute and evolve an incremental modernization strategy, safely transitioning legacy systems into well-bounded services while maintaining reliability and continuity

• Decompose monolithic systems incrementally using patterns such as strangler fig • Manage coexistence between legacy and modern systems during transition • Design clear service boundaries, contracts, and data ownership models • Ensure backward compatibility and safe evolution of APIs and data during migration • Improve performance, scalability, and maintainability as part of modernization efforts • Identify and prioritize high-impact areas for migration based on risk and value

Ideal Experience:

• Hands-on experience incrementally modernizing monolithic systems in production environments • Experience with migration patterns such as strangler fig, parallel run, or phased rollouts • Strong understanding of system decomposition, including service boundaries and data ownership • Experience maintaining backward compatibility and managing API/data contracts during system evolution • Experience working with legacy systems and evolving them under real-world constraints • Experience debugging and validating behavior across both legacy and newly extracted services • Ability to balance migration velocity with system stability and risk • Familiarity with observability practices to validate system behavior during migrations • Experience using AI tools to analyze legacy systems, understand behavior, or accelerate refactoring and migration efforts

Qualifications

Software Development

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with ownership of production systems and operational improvements
  • Strong backend development experience (Ruby, Node.js, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, service contracts, distributed systems, and common software design patterns
  • Experience working across backend systems, APIs, and production environments

Quality & Testing

  • Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and API layers
  • Strong ownership of code quality, including testing, debugging, and validation

AWS & Cloud-Native Experience

  • Experience building and operating cloud-native services in AWS
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern deployment workflows

Observability & Production Operations

  • Experience using observability tools (e.g. Datadog or equivalent) to monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues
  • Familiarity with incident response and continuous reliability improvements

On-Call & Incident Response

  • Willingness to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation and support production issue resolution

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Experience with or strong interest in AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor) and the ability to effectively evaluate AI-generated solutions

Company Description

One Identity enables organizations of all sizes to better secure, manage, monitor, protect, and analyze information and infrastructure to help fuel innovation and drive their businesses forward. With team members around the globe, we intend to continue to grow revenues and add value to customers.

When you join our team, you will have the opportunity to build and develop products at a scale few others can provide. Our product portfolio serves a large base of customers and we are addressing the strategic imperatives for enterprise businesses. Working with some of the most talented employees the industry has to offer, we provide enhanced career opportunities for team members to learn and grow in a rapidly changing environment.

One Identity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: One Identity is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. One Identity will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. One Identity encourages applicants of all ages.

Job Description

VICTAULIC

Title: Commercial/Mechanical Business Development Executive

Location: San Francisco Bay Area (remote)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department/Function: Sales/Business Development

Immigration sponsorship: None

ABOUT VICTAULIC

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.

An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

  • We build from within.
  • We stand behind our people.
  • We foster an environment for constant learning.
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

The Business Development Executive (BDE) spearheads strategic business development initiatives within a designated geographic territory, serving a pivotal role in advancing Victaulic solutions. Focused on enhancing specification standing through a market-centric approach, their primary objectives revolve around implementing the market box strategy, collecting valuable market intelligence, and obtaining comprehensive project information, including detailed scopes of work. The BDE proactively cultivates Victaulic opportunities by targeting, engaging, and influencing key stakeholders, including owners and engineers.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD & OWN

  • Strategically evaluate assigned territory, collaborating with the Regional Business Development Manager and/or Divisional Sales Leader to prioritize target accounts.
  • Develop and execute an annual business plan aimed at elevating Victaulic's specification standing, emphasizing a comprehensive market box strategy encompassing both master and project specifications, as well as owner guidelines.
  • Drive the penetration and expansion of Victaulic's influence within assigned accounts (owners, engineers, GCs) by crafting and fortifying owner guidelines, master specifications, and project specifications.
  • Leverage Salesforce to effectively capture, share, and collaborate account and project details with the commercial sales team, ensuring seamless communication and coordination.
  • Facilitate effective project handoffs at the appropriate phase of the project lifecycle with the commercial sales team.
  • Attains comprehensive expertise in various aspects, including:
    • Product features and benefits, account influences, market and product applications, and technical language, encompassing material science knowledge.
    • Specifications as an industry document, comprehending both content and language intricacies.
    • Competitive products and their positioning in the market
  • Cultivate and foster industry connections with clients and prospects.
  • Stay abreast of market trends and competitor dynamics.
  • Employ strategic social engineering to enhance relationships and gather market intelligence.
  • Engage with local trade organizations and professional associations, actively becoming integral to the industry fabric in the assigned territory.
  • Fulfill additional responsibilities as assigned.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or construction management strongly preferred.
  • Previous sales experience preferably related to the commercial construction industry or engineering fields.
  • Proven track record of success, including business development, sales, and account management while achieving targets and complex sales.
  • Established owner group relationships in healthcare, higher education, and airports throughout the area.
  • Understanding of HVAC piping system solutions.
  • Established owner group relationships.
  • Capable of lifting 50+ pounds.
  • Willingness to travel overnight as required by the position and territory

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Engineering skills in writing and developing design specifications a plus.
  • Proficient project management and communication skills.
  • A self-starter who enjoys working in an autonomous leadership role while being a member of a team of highly skilled colleagues.
  • Ability to demonstrate drive, resiliency, and adaptability while possessing a team mindset.
  • Ability to demonstrate learning agility, creative thinking, problem solving and resourcefulness.
  • Solid organizational and time management skills; able to work in a virtual setting with minimal supervision.

WHAT WE OFFER

Build A Better Career

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Career development programs and internal promotion pathways—we build from within
  • Tuition reimbursement and continuous learning opportunities

Build A Better Future

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Retirement savings plans with company match
  • Life insurance and disability coverage

Build A Better You

  • Paid time off, holidays, and flexible work arrangements where applicable
  • Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and wellness resources
  • Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another

Build A Better World

Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this position is typically between $150,000.00–$210,000.00 annually. Top end of range can be exceeded, as actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, skills, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for variable compensation in addition to the full benefits package described above.

IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP

Victaulic does not provide immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, or other work visa sponsorship) for this position. All applicants must be currently authorized to work in the applicable country on a full-time basis without the need for employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Victaulic is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EOE/M/F/Vets/Disabled) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, gender, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic data, or other legally protected status. Background checks may be required as part of our pre-employment process.

VICTAULIC STAFFING PARTNER COMMUNICATION POLICY

All staffing agencies are strictly forbidden from directly contacting any Victaulic employees, except those within the Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. All communications, inquiries and candidate submissions must be routed through Victaulic’s Human Resources/Talent Acquisition team. Non-compliance with this policy may result in the suspension of partnership, cancellation of the current contract, and/or the imposition of a mandatory probation period before any future business can resume. Additionally, non-compliance may lead to a permanent ban on future business. This policy ensures a streamlined and compliant recruitment process.

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

jobs.description:
Job Title:

Contract Senior Talent Acquisition Sourcer

Job Description:

The Senior Sourcer is a contract opening on the Talent Acquisition team responsible for delivering high-quality sourcing and candidate-screening support to Talent Acquisition recruiters. Working in close partnership with assigned recruiters, this individual will typically support 10+ requisitions at a time and build targeted, diverse pipelines of qualified active and passive candidates. The Senior Sourcer will conduct comprehensive initial screens, document candidate qualifications and motivations, and present fully screened candidates who meet the requirements of each role. Success will be measured through defined key performance indicators related to pipeline generation, candidate quality, speed, responsiveness, conversion, data accuracy, and recruiter satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities


  • Partner closely with Talent Acquisition recruiters to understand assigned requisitions, required qualifications, target candidate profiles, sourcing priorities, and service expectations.
  • Manage sourcing and initial screening activity for approximately 10+ requisitions at a time, adjusting priorities as business needs change.
  • Develop and execute tailored sourcing strategies using job boards, professional networks, internal databases, social media, web research, referrals, talent communities, and other relevant channels.
  • Identify, engage, and cultivate relationships with active and passive candidates for current and anticipated hiring needs.
  • Conduct thorough initial screens to assess experience, technical and functional qualifications, career interests, compensation expectations, work authorization, location requirements, availability, and overall alignment with the opportunity.
  • Present recruiters with fully screened qualified candidates supported by clear, accurate, and concise screening notes.
  • Maintain consistent communication with recruiters regarding pipeline health, candidate feedback, market conditions, sourcing challenges, and recommended adjustments.
  • Build and maintain reusable talent pipelines for recurring, high-volume, specialized, and difficult-to-fill roles.
  • Maintain timely and accurate candidate activity, dispositions, notes, and pipeline data in Workday and other approved recruiting tools.
  • Deliver a professional, responsive, and inclusive candidate experience through clear communication and timely follow-up.
  • Contribute to Talent Acquisition initiatives, sourcing campaigns, talent-mapping projects, process improvements, and other priorities as assigned.

Required Skills & Competencies


  • Demonstrated experience sourcing and screening candidates in a corporate agency, or recruitment process outsourcing environment.
  • Strong ability to identify and engage passive talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, databases, social platforms, web research, and creative sourcing techniques.
  • Experience conducting structured candidate screens and evaluating qualifications against defined job requirements.
  • Ability to manage 10+ concurrent requisitions, balance competing priorities, and consistently meet established deadlines and service expectations.
  • Strong partnership skills and a service-oriented approach to supporting Talent Acquisition recruiters.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to summarize candidate qualifications clearly and objectively.
  • Working knowledge of applicant tracking systems and candidate relationship management tools; Workday experience is preferred.
  • Comfort using recruiting data and metrics to evaluate sourcing effectiveness and adjust strategies.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to accurate documentation and process compliance.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, changing environment while remaining responsive to recruiter and business needs.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience preferred.
  • Experience sourcing for manufacturing, operations, engineering, research and development, technical, or other specialized roles is preferred; knowledge of the chemical, plastics, or semiconductor industries is a plus.

Success Measures (PACE-Aligned)


People: Builds strong relationships with recruiters and provides an excellent candidate experience.


Accountability: Meets or exceeds SLA targets, and pipeline generation.


Creativity: Develops innovative sourcing strategies and leverages market insights to influence decisions.


Excellence: Delivers high-quality hires consistently, maintains data accuracy, and strengthens Entegris’ reputation as an employer of choice.

The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

Position Overview

The Senior Director, Investor Relations serves as the company's primary liaison to the investment community and a strategic advisor to the CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors on investor sentiment, market perceptions, valuation drivers, and capital markets trends. This leader owns the company’s investor relations strategy and external investment narrative, translating technology roadmap , software and platform capabilities, business strategy, and financial performance into a compelling investment thesis that strengthens investor confidence and supports long-term shareholder value creation.

The Senior Director builds and maintains relationships with investors, analysts, rating agencies, and other key stakeholders, while bringing external market intelligence and investor perspectives back into the organization to inform enterprise decision-making. The role partners closely with Finance, Strategy, Legal, Communications, and business leaders to ensure clear, consistent, credible, and transparent communication with the investment community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the company's investor relations strategy, ensuring the investment community has a clear understanding of the company's strategy, performance, growth opportunities, transformation priorities, and long-term value creation objectives.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO, CFO, and Board of Directors on investor sentiment, shareholder expectations, ownership trends, valuation drivers, capital allocation perspectives, market dynamics, and emerging risks and opportunities.
  • Develop and continually evolve the company’s investment thesis and external financial narrative, translating complex technology, product architecture, software and cloud business models, and technical differentiation into clear value drivers for tech-focused investors and analysts. Ensure consistency and compelling articulation of the company’s strategy, competitive differentiation, financial performance, and long-term value proposition across investor-facing communications.
  • Develop and execute a proactive investor targeting and engagement strategy, building strong relationships with existing and prospective technology and software sector portfolio managers, tech-specialist equity analysts, sell-side analysts, rating agencies, and broader capital markets stakeholders to strengthen the company’s credibility, visibility, and long-term shareholder base.
  • Gather, analyze, and synthesize market intelligence, including investor feedback, analyst perspectives and models, peer and competitive performance, valuation trends, shareholder composition, and broader capital markets developments; translate insights into actionable recommendations for executive leadership and the Board.
  • Lead the company’s investor-facing communications and engagement, including quarterly earnings materials and calls, investor presentations, Analyst Days, conferences, roadshows, shareholder outreach, annual meeting support, and other high-profile investor interactions.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Communications, Strategy, and business leaders to ensure accurate, transparent, consistent, and compliant investor communications and public disclosures, including earnings materials, SEC filings, annual reports, proxy materials, and other shareholder communications.
  • Shape investor communications around significant strategic and business transformation initiatives, translating complex enterprise changes, strategic transactions, and capital allocation decisions into clear and credible external narratives and preparing executive leadership for periods of heightened investor and market attention.
  • Monitor shareholder composition, governance trends, analyst coverage, trading dynamics, and capital markets developments, advising leadership on potential implications for enterprise value, investor confidence, and the company’s market positioning.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing Investor Relations function, establishing strong capabilities, processes, performance measures, and best practices that increase the effectiveness and impact of the function.
  • Operate as both a strategic leader and hands-on contributor, personally driving high-quality analysis, executive messaging, presentations, earnings preparation, and investor communications when appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience in Investor Relations, Finance, Treasury, Equity Research, Investment Banking, Corporate Development, Strategy, or a related capital markets discipline, with significant experience supporting enterprise software, cloud/SaaS, digital infrastructure, or high-tech publicly traded company.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience within Investor Relations, Finance, Capital Markets, or a related function, with demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence senior executives and external stakeholders.
  • Significant public-company Investor Relations experience, including direct involvement in earnings, investor and analyst engagement, public disclosures, and executive preparation.
  • Deep understanding of capital markets, valuation methodologies, financial statements and performance metrics, investor expectations, shareholder engagement practices, tech/software valuation metrics, and capital allocation considerations.
  • Strong knowledge of SEC regulations, Regulation FD, disclosure requirements, securities laws, and public-company reporting obligations.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex financial, strategic, competitive, and market information and translate it into a clear and compelling investment narrative.
  • Proven ability to establish credibility and influence with investors, analysts, executive leadership teams, and Boards of Directors.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex topics with clarity and precision.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, analytical rigor, sound judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in high-visibility situations with competing priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to represent the company effectively with investors, analysts, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA, CFA, CPA, or other relevant advanced degree or professional designation.
  • Experience leading Investor Relations for a publicly traded company.
  • Experience within telecommunications, technology, infrastructure, or other capital-intensive industries.
  • Experience supporting significant strategic transactions, capital raises, mergers and acquisitions, Analyst Days, or major enterprise transformation initiatives.

The Commercial Legal Team at Pinterest negotiates Pinterest’s inbound and supplier agreements. We are looking for a Senior Commercial Counsel with a strong background in negotiating complex SaaS, AI and cloud infrastructure agreements to join our team. The position will manage workloads for and relationships with several of our cross functional partners, including Engineering, Security, Privacy, Finance, Procurement and IT. This role will play an important part in supporting Pinterest’s cloud strategy across multiple platforms and helping the business efficiently scale its technology and infrastructure partnerships.

We are Olsson. We engineer and design solutions that improve the world around us. As a company, we promise to always be responsive, transparent, and focused on results – for our people, our clients, and our company.

Job Description

At Olsson, we help our clients in multiple states navigate complex historical and archaeological compliance landscapes with ease. We ensure proactive adherence to key historical preservation laws and regulations, including Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA) review process. Our innovative methods empower clients to achieve project goals while preserving our historical heritage.

Olsson is seeking candidates who meet the United States Secretary of Interior (SOI) Professional Qualifications Standards (36 CFR 61). The ideal candidate could be an archeologist or an architectural historian. This role is multifaceted and critical in ensuring compliance with state, local, and federal historical and archaeological preservation regulations while promoting sustainable projects. In this role, you will lead compliance projects, perform cultural resource assessments, engage with regulatory agencies, coordinate with clients, and collaborate with team members and external consultants. You will have the opportunity to mentor and train others in complex compliance work, as well as lead client and regulatory meetings.

Join us and be part of a team that’s making a real impact!

jobs.excerpt: Twin Health At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care.
jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

Direct mail drives roughly 59% of Twin's member registrations today — the single largest acquisition channel — but it has never had a dedicated owner. Scan rate has declined from 3.27% to 1.01% over the past eleven months, cost per piece is not tracked, and reporting lags real send dates by about two weeks. This role owns direct mail end to end: cadence, creative testing, vendor management, and cost accounting — with a mandate to fix the channel's biggest problems first and build the instrumentation that makes every decision here reusable as training data for Twin's next-generation, individually-targeted acquisition engine.

This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role for someone who wants full ownership of a channel that already moves the business, with a direct hand in shaping how it gets measured and automated going forward.

Responsibilities

Direct Mail Program Ownership

  • Own the direct mail channel end to end: drop cadence, creative testing, cost-per-piece accounting, and the vendor relationship with our print partner (RRD).
  • Diagnose and reverse the scan-rate decline (3.27% → 1.01% over the past 11 months) — determine whether the driver is creative fatigue, cadence, list saturation, or contact-data quality before recommending a fix.
  • Lead the shift from partner-batch mailing (one drop per partner per month) to lead-type-triggered mailing, so a newly-eligible, high-value lead receives its piece inside its launch window rather than whenever its partner's drop happens to fall.

Instrumentation & Decision Logging

  • Log every mailer, variant, and segment decision with what was considered and why — not just what ultimately shipped — so today's judgment becomes tomorrow's training data.
  • Partner with the Technical Lead and Senior Marketing Analyst to close known data gaps in the channel: partner-grain send records, scan-rate tracking, and per-piece cost.
  • Ensure every send is joinable to an individual lead record, not just reconcilable at the aggregate or partner level.

Testing & Optimization

  • Design and run direct mail A/B tests — messaging, format, cadence — with a stated hypothesis and success metric before launch.
  • Build on the existing Motivation vs. Barrier messaging framework already in use, and extend it with new axes as evidence supports.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Marketing on creative production and approval — this role tags and measures content; Marketing produces and approves it.
  • Coordinate with the partner/client team on partner-specific creative approval SLAs and marketing permission tiers before any send.
  • AI-Powered Execution
  • Use AI tools such as Claude to draft creative variant copy, summarize test results, and accelerate reporting.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in direct mail or offline/print channel marketing, ideally in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent industry
  • Experience managing a direct mail vendor/print relationship (RRD or comparable), including cost negotiation and production timelines
  • Comfortable working with campaign and lead-level data in a CRM (Salesforce) and marketing automation platform (Braze or comparable)
  • Experience designing and reading A/B tests, with a working understanding of sample size and significance
  • Strong project management skills — this channel runs on hard print and drop deadlines
  • Able to reason about lead-grain data concepts — understands why "how many pieces did we mail" and "how many of these specific leads received mail" are different, both-necessary questions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a highly regulated industry (healthcare, financial services, insurance) with partner or client creative-approval workflows
  • Experience with lifecycle/cadence-based marketing (triggered off an individual's stage) rather than calendar-batch marketing
  • SQL literacy
  • Experience partnering with data or analytics teams to close measurement gaps in an existing channel
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $90,000 - $110,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan
Salary range for US jobs
US Salary Range
$90,000—$115,000 USD

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

Our Culture:

  • Take full responsibility for every outcome—no excuses.
  • Obsess over results. We're here to make a measurable impact.
  • We’re data-obsessed. We let numbers, not opinions, guide our decisions.

  • No ego. The best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.
  • Radical candour. We give and receive honest feedback to fuel growth.

Work from anywhere

Embrace our remote-first culture that prioritises impact over location. Work from wherever you're most productive, while enjoying meaningful connections with the team in London from time to time. We bring everyone together regularly for inspiring sessions and great conversations over amazing food—because the best ideas often start with "what if?"

Role overview

We’re hiring a Growth Manager (Apps) to own performance-driven user acquisition for mobile products inside a growth squad.

This is a media buying and measurement-heavy role. You’ll be responsible for planning, executing, and scaling multi-channel app campaigns, building and optimising web-to-app flows, and driving efficient growth across both iOS and Android.

You will be deeply hands-on with:

  • platform algorithms
  • attribution frameworks
  • signal engineering
  • payback modelling
  • budget allocation decisions

This role is not creative-led. You will collaborate closely with Creative Strategists, but your responsibility is media performance, measurement integrity, and economic scale.

For the right person, this role evolves into Growth Lead (Apps), shaping how Aperture scales acquisition, signal quality, and monetisation for mobile-first businesses.

Key responsibilities

Acquisition strategy and execution

  • Own media buying for apps across the appropriate channel mix (Apple Search Ads, Google App Campaigns, Meta, TikTok, programmatic).
  • Structure campaigns correctly for app objectives (install, trial, subscription, value-based optimisation).
  • Allocate budgets based on payback, signal quality, and incremental performance — not vanity metrics.
  • Design and manage both web-to-app and app-direct flows, choosing routing based on economics and tracking reliability.
  • Build weekly structured testing roadmaps (channel, budget, optimisation event, geo expansion, creative inputs).

Measurement, attribution, and signal engineering

  • Set up and maintain reliable attribution across:
    • SKAN
    • MMPs (e.g., AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular)
    • first-party event frameworks
  • Understand the limitations of:
    • probabilistic vs deterministic attribution
    • SKAN vs AEM vs platform-reported metrics
  • Design and refine signal strategies:
    • AEM configuration
    • Advanced data (ADC)
    • server-side events / CAPI
    • event prioritisation
  • Reconcile platform data vs MMP vs backend subscription data.
  • Communicate measurement gaps and propose realistic optimisation paths.

This role requires comfort with ambiguity in attribution — and the judgement to optimise within it.

Funnel, onboarding, and monetisation economics

  • Map and monitor the full user journey:
    ad → store/web → install → onboarding → trial → subscription → retention
  • Diagnose performance issues across the funnel using cohort data.
  • Model payback periods by cohort (D0, D7, D30+).
  • Adjust budget recommendations based on:
    • CAC vs LTV
    • cash flow constraints
    • subscription mix
    • geographic profitability
  • Identify when store conversion, onboarding friction, or paywall design is limiting scale — and escalate with clear hypotheses.

App store and conversion optimisation

  • Optimise App Store and Play Store listings (screenshots, previews, metadata, localisation).
  • Monitor install-to-open and open-to-trial conversion.
  • Feed paid learnings into ASO strategy.
  • Track impact of store experiments on downstream performance, not just installs.

Web-to-app and subscription tooling

  • Plan and optimise web funnels supporting web-to-app or web-subscription flows.
  • Work with tools such as RevenueCat, FunnelFox, Web2Wave (or equivalents).
  • Connect ad spend, subscription data, and backend revenue into unified reporting.
  • Identify tracking breaks and solve them with structured approaches.

Creative collaboration (not ownership)

  • Translate performance data into clear creative inputs and hypotheses.
  • Work with Creative Strategists to:
    • prioritise tests
    • define success metrics
    • interpret results
  • Maintain tagging systems and structured learning logs.
  • Focus on performance impact, not creative production.

Communication and client ownership

  • Lead performance reviews clearly and confidently.
  • Explain platform limitations and tracking realities to clients.
  • Communicate:
    • what happened
    • why it happened
    • what changes next
  • Maintain short feedback loops across performance, creative, CRM, and product teams.

Requirements

Experience

  • 3+ years in mobile performance marketing or app growth.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Meta (App campaigns)
    • Google App Campaigns
    • Apple Search Ads
    • TikTok Ads
  • Experience using MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular.
  • Demonstrable experience scaling subscription apps or trial-based products.

Skills and mindset

  • Deep comfort with attribution ambiguity and signal constraints.
  • Strong commercial judgement - you think in payback, not just CPI.
  • Comfortable working with:
    • SKAN
    • AEM
    • CAPI / server-side tracking
  • Able to debug tracking and event mapping issues logically.
  • Structured, analytical thinker.
  • Clear communicator in client settings.
  • Not reliant on creative to save performance.

What this role is not

  • Not a creative strategist role.
  • Not a pure generalist growth role.
  • Not junior.
  • Not a reporting-only role.

This is a performance-first, algorithm-aware, economics-driven role.

Why this role matters

As privacy frameworks tighten and signal quality degrades, scaling mobile acquisition requires stronger judgement, cleaner signal design, and tighter economics.

This role is central to:

  • protecting measurement integrity
  • scaling budgets responsibly
  • maintaining payback discipline
  • future-proofing Aperture’s mobile growth capability

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Opportunity

Email is Twin's existing digital acquisition channel, but it's currently under-performing a fixable problem: high-volume sends are landing in Gmail's Promotions tab, which has paused content testing until placement is resolved. SMS is the opposite situation — entirely net-new, zero SMS sent today, but built on the same Braze platform Email already runs on, so there's no new infrastructure to stand up, only a new channel to launch on infrastructure that already exists.

This role owns both channels end to end, reporting to the Associate Director of Acquisition Strategy & Channel Ops, who sets cross-channel priority and sequencing across Direct Mail, Email/SMS, and Search & Discovery. This is an execution and testing role, not a standalone-strategy role — the "what and when" across channels is orchestrated one level up; this role owns the "how well" on Email and SMS specifically.

  • Own email end to end: creative testing, cadence, segmentation execution, and the day-to-day Braze platform relationship.
  • Resolve the Gmail Promotions inbox-placement issue currently capping email's reach and blocking content testing — the immediate, dated problem this role inherits on day one.

SMS Buildout (net-new)

  • Build Twin's first SMS program from scratch on the existing Braze platform — greenfield channel, not greenfield infrastructure.

  • Instrumentation & Decision Logging

Testing & Optimization

  • Design and run email and SMS A/B tests with a stated hypothesis and success metric before launch.
  • Build on the existing Motivation vs. Barrier messaging framework already validated in market, and extend it to SMS as that channel comes online.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Reports to the Associate Director, Acquisition Strategy & Channel Ops, who orchestrates priority and sequencing across all channel specialists and partners with the Senior Marketing Analyst and Technical Lead on measurement and infrastructure — this role executes within that direction.
  • Partner with Marketing on creative production and approval — this role tags and measures content; Marketing produces and approves it.

AI-Powered Execution

  • Use AI tools such as Claude to draft creative variants and accelerate reporting.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in email marketing or marketing automation, ideally hands-on with Braze or a comparable ESP/CDP
  • Direct experience launching or scaling an SMS program, including consent and TCPA compliance basics
  • Strong grasp of deliverability and inbox-placement mechanics (sender reputation, authentication, list hygiene, Promotions-tab avoidance)
  • Comfortable working with lead-level data and campaign reporting in a CRM (Salesforce) and marketing automation platform
  • Experience designing and reading A/B tests

Preferred
