jobs.excerpt: Senior Sales Closer — AI Automation and Agent Solutions Base: Base: $120K–$150K | OTE: $155K–$185K | Top Performers: $200K+ (Uncapped) Full-Time | Individual Contributor WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years.
jobs.description:
Senior Sales Closer — AI Automation and Agent Solutions

Base: Base: $120K–$150K | OTE: $155K–$185K | Top Performers: $200K+ (Uncapped)
Full-Time | Individual Contributor

WHO WE ARE

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for — and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

OVERVIEW

We hand you a full calendar of qualified prospects every day. You close. No prospecting. No cold calling. No pipeline generation. No RFP writing. No conference schmoozing. Your only job is to get on Zoom, run the conversation, and close.

Our top-performing closers earn $200K+ annually. Here's the math: 8 deals/month at an average of $8,000 MRR ($96K ACV) with accelerators and retention bonuses. The commission is uncapped. The leads are provided. The product sells. You just have to be the person who can close it.

If you’re currently spending 30–50% of your time generating your own pipeline, imagine what you could do with that time back. That’s what this role offers.

WHAT WE DO

Interdependence is the fastest-growing AI-powered marketing communications firm in the country with a growing automation solution. We build and deploy AI systems that help companies efficiently scale operations, revenue -faster than traditional teams.

What makes us different: we don’t just advise, we implement and guarantee outcomes. While traditional agencies charge retainers for effort, we deliver measurable results through automation, agent creation, data, and execution. Our technology identifies opportunities, deploys workflows, and drives performance across marketing, sales, and operations.

We typically work with the C suite at companies with 50–200+ employees across a range of industries. Our average engagement is $8–15K/month, with deals ranging from $8K to $20K/month. We are scaling and need closers who want to be part of that run.

THE ROLE

You will run 4–5 qualified sales presentations per day over Zoom with decision-makers who have already expressed interest. The sales cycle is 2 calls: Call 1 is discovery and qualification. Call 2 is a customized proposal and close. The typical cycle is 30–60 days.

Your monthly target is 6-8 closed deals. Our team writes the proposal, and you schedule the close. You are supported by a sales coach, a proposal team, and a leadership team that has built and scaled this motion across multiple brands.

This is an individual contributor closing role. You are not managing a team. You are not building a pipeline. You are not writing decks or attending conferences. You are closing. Every day, all day. If that sounds like the best job in the world to you, keep reading.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Interdependence’s core offering is AI automation systems that drive revenue and operational efficiency at $8K–$15K/month. But you won’t be limited to one product line. We operate multiple solution areas, and top performers sell across the portfolio:

AI Automation and Agentic Systems — end-to-end workflow automation and agentic systems across marketing, sales, and operations. Replace manual work with scalable systems.

You start with core automation solutions and expand as you ramp. The best closers sell across multiple offerings and maximize their earnings.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • You’ve closed deals at our price point. Previous average deal of $5K–$20K/month ($60K–$240K ACV). You know what it takes to get a CEO to commit $8-10K/month because you’ve done it.
  • You close 5–8 deals per month, personally. Your deals, your name on the board. You know your close rate, deal size, and monthly count without looking it up.
  • You sell to decision-makers. CEOs, Founders and VP of Operations at 50–200+ person companies. You speak their language.
  • You’ve sold services, not just software. Automation, consulting, managed services — you understand the consultative sale tied to recurring revenue.
  • You thrive on volume. 8 deals at $8-10K beats one whale at $40-50K. A packed Zoom calendar excites you.
  • You qualify hard. You’ve walked away from closable deals because the client was a bad fit.
  • We teach the domain in 30 days. What we can’t teach is how to close at $8K/month. Bring the skill. We handle the rest.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

  • Enterprise seller stepping down — if your average deal was $500K+ with 6–12 month cycles, this is a different motion.
  • You want to manage a team — this is IC. If you’re here as a stepping stone to VP, we’re not the right fit.
  • Relationship-first seller — if you need 6–9 months before asking for the business, our 2-call close will feel uncomfortable.
  • Previous deals under $3K/month — the $8K conversation requires executive presence that smaller deals don’t demand.

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short note with three things:

  1. Your average deal size (MRR or ACV) and how many you closed per month at your most recent role.
  1. Your target total compensation and how you’d expect base vs. variable to split.
  1. One sentence on why you want to close instead of manage.

No cover letter essays. Just the numbers and the reason. If the numbers are right, we’ll be on a Zoom within 48 hours. We move fast, we don’t ghost, and we’ll tell you directly whether it’s a fit.

POSITION SUMMARY

Title: Medical Science Liaison (MSL) - GI Oncology

Natera is a clinical genetic testing company specializing in non-invasive, cell-free DNA (cfDNA) and liquid biopsy testing. We are seeking a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) for our Gastrointestinal (GI) Oncology portfolio to primarily support Signatera, our personalized, tumor-informed minimal residual disease (MRD) test. In this field-based role, you will serve as a scientific expert responsible for engaging GI oncology healthcare providers, sharing peer-reviewed clinical data, and delivering accurate information that proactively informs disease management.

At Natera, we remember there is a person behind every sample. The MSL operates with a high degree of ownership and urgency, delivering advanced genetic testing data that changes patient outcomes when timing and accuracy matter most. This role focuses on building strong scientific relationships, delivering clear and accurate clinical education, and bringing back actionable insights from the field to change the management of disease worldwide.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Establish and maintain scientific relationships with GI oncology healthcare providers and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within a defined territory.

  • Deliver accurate, balanced, and clinically relevant education on Natera’s GI oncology molecular diagnostics and clinical data.

  • Drive territory strategy quickly and adapt as Medical Affairs priorities shift.

  • Identify and communicate field insights, including GI oncology treatment trends, unmet clinical needs, and competitive dynamics.

  • Respond to unsolicited medical inquiries in a timely, compliant, and scientifically rigorous manner.

  • Support execution of Medical Affairs initiatives, including advisory boards and medical education programs.

  • Act as a subject matter expert on gastrointestinal oncology disease states, clinical data, and the broader diagnostics market.

  • Partner closely with commercial and clinical teams to support patient care without compromising scientific truth.

  • Take personal accountability for doing things the right way, adhering strictly to healthcare regulations and internal standards.

  • Support and coordinate clinical trial and research initiatives at academic institutions and regional study sites.

  • Accurately track territory engagement and document actionable clinical insights.

  • Travel 60-70% across the territory for clinical engagement and conferences.

  • Adapt quickly to emerging scientific and clinical needs across the GI oncology portfolio.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced healthcare or scientific degree preferred (Ph.D., Pharm.D., M.D., D.N.P.), with a minimum of a Master's degree required.

  • Prior Medical Affairs or MSL experience in GI oncology or molecular diagnostics preferred.

  • Must reside within the assigned territory.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Technical expertise and the research ability to clearly explain complex genetic testing data and clinical products to GI oncology specialists.

  • Experience establishing strong, collaborative working relationships with internal teams and external customers.

  • Ability to work independently and remotely while maintaining a strong team-oriented work ethic.

  • Navigate ambiguity effectively and take the initiative to build structure and processes where none currently exist.

  • Use clear, straightforward language to communicate clinical evidence effectively without heavy jargon.

  • Demonstrate flexibility and the capacity to adjust quickly to unexpected clinical tasks or strategy shifts.

  • High level of personal accountability, ownership, and sound scientific judgment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • This is a remote, field-based position requiring daily use of a computer and the ability to travel extensively.

  • Duties require flexibility around scheduling to support evening or weekend clinical meetings when necessary.

  • Employees must complete required training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance, and security within the first 30 days of hire.

  • Must maintain current status on all Natera organizational training requirements.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$145,000—$175,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

How to apply

Company Summary:

Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang AI, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact.

What Your Experience Will Be:

As a Client Experience Manager at Slang AI, you’ll own the end-to-end customer journey for our SMB clients — from onboarding through long-term success and day-to-day support. You’ll guide customers through their initial rollout, transition seamlessly into serving as their long-term success manager, and directly manage the support inbox during business hours, where many of their most important interactions occur.
Because support volume is currently low (fewer than 60 inquiries per month across 1,500+ customers), this role offers the opportunity to both deliver excellent frontline support and help design how support scales as we grow. You’ll gain unique visibility into customer needs in real time while influencing the tools, processes, and standards that will shape support as the business expands.
This unique scope means you’ll be both a strategic advisor and a hands-on partner, ensuring customers launch smoothly, adopt key features, resolve challenges quickly, and realize the full value of Slang. By owning these critical touch points, you’ll have a large sphere of influence over customer outcomes, shaping retention, adoption, and satisfaction across a significant segment of the business.
In addition, you’ll play a key role in our digital customer success program — helping define and refine automated success sequences to ensure accuracy, consistency, and strong adoption results. This work ensures customers experience the same hospitality-first service at scale, while giving you a direct impact on how Slang drives measurable results for our clients.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow:

At Slang, we believe success starts with great execution and great service. In this role, you’ll gain valuable experience managing full customer lifecycles and working with hospitality operators in a fast-paced environment. You’ll learn how to onboard, support, and grow a book of business with autonomy, while contributing to scalable processes that improve outcomes across the team. We offer training, feedback, and growth opportunities to help you level up in customer success, technical product fluency, and strategic account management.

What Success Looks Like

  • Driving Long-Term Success: You are responsible for the health and success of your assigned accounts. You ensure customers are seeing clear outcomes, meeting their goals, and staying on track for renewal.
  • Building Trusted Relationship: You build strong relationships with a range of customer stakeholders — from General Managers to Operations Leaders — and know how to tailor your approach depending on their needs.
  • Renewals & Retention: You own the renewal process and are accountable for maintaining and growing account revenue. You identify risks early, take action to resolve issues, and keep customers satisfied and committed.
  • Surfacing Growth Opportunity: You surface expansion opportunities (e.g. additional locations or use cases) and work with Sales to execute. You contribute to the team’s Net Revenue Retention (NRR) goal.
  • Feature Adoption & Product Fluency: You guide customers through product updates, encourage usage of key features, and tie adoption back to business outcomes. You’re expected to understand and explain Slang’s value.
  • Onboarding and Success Planning: You create simple account plans to track customer goals, key contacts, risks, and growth potential. You align internal teams around each plan to support execution.
  • Voice of the Customer: You escalate customer feedback internally and contribute insights that improve product and service. You partner with Product and Support to advocate for customer needs.
  • Hospitality-First Service: You respond quickly, handle challenges with professionalism, and make interactions easy for customers. You aim to create a positive experience in every conversation.

What You Will Bring

  • Customer Focus: You care about helping customers succeed. You’re responsive, thoughtful, and proactive.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or client-facing roles. Background in restaurants or hospitality tech is strongly preferred.
  • Business Acumen: You understand restaurant operations and how to align Slang’s value with business goals. You’re comfortable working with executives and frontline staff alike.
  • Communication: You’re clear and concise in both written and verbal communication. You know how to explain ideas, give updates, and lead customer conversations.
  • Ownership: You manage your book of business with attention to detail. You’re accountable for renewals, engagement, and outcomes.
  • Adaptability: You’re comfortable in a fast-changing environment and open to feedback. You handle ambiguity and know how to prioritize.
  • Preferred: Experience with restaurant operations, phone systems, or reservation platforms is a plus.

How Work Affects My Life:

As a Client Experience Manager for SMBs, you’ll directly contribute to the success of hospitality teams. Your work helps restaurant staff be more productive, improve guest service, and hit their business goals. In return, Slang supports you with competitive pay, benefits, and a culture that values performance and teamwork. You’ll have clear goals, a meaningful role, and the opportunity to grow.

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang.ai. We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).
We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)
Learner Fervor. We take every opportunity to learn (especially when it’s hard)
Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)
SMB MVP. We’re an expert member of our customers’ teams (we earn their trust)

jobs.title: Director of Product Management — MetaDefender Cloud
jobs.excerpt: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance.
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

This is a hands-on, business-owner product leadership role, not a pure strategy or coordination seat. An experienced product manager reports to you, with full people responsibility, and dedicated cloud engineering teams partner with you daily. You operate like a general manager, fluent in packaging, pricing models, and metering, and conversant in NDR and GDR. You understand the whole business, from sales enablement and marketing through inbound and digital motion to field events and channel partners, and hold every investment to a strong ROI. You also carry the platform responsibility everything else depends on: performance, availability, migration, and cost. You bring an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI in the day-to-day work of the team to maximize efficiency and output.

Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.

We are seeking an exceptional product leader to own the vision, strategy, and execution of MetaDefender Cloud, the verdict as an API. Enterprises, governments, and technology partners send it files and get back a decision they can trust (“is this file safe to admit?”) at any volume. This is business ownership of a trust-critical enterprise cloud: the commercial ladder from self-serve developer entry to a top tier for regulated buyers, and everything that makes it credible, from contractual SLAs, availability, and failover to compliance, cost efficiency, and a platform other OPSWAT services build on. You will grow the business through product-led motion, cloud marketplaces, distribution channels, and a Technology Partners program that makes joining our ecosystem a product action, not a sales project.

MetaDefender Cloud delivers OPSWAT’s prevention technologies (multiscanning, Deep CDR, and AI-driven analysis) as a cloud service, and is the shared platform behind a growing family of OPSWAT cloud offerings. This role owns that business end to end:

  • The Prevention Ladder:one coherent tier ladder from self-serve developer entry to full enterprise, sold to one buyer who moves up as throughput and analysis depth grow.
  • The Regulated Enterprise:the top of the ladder: dedicated capacity, the strictest SLAs, large-file support, and a strict data-privacy and data-handling posture for regulated industries.
  • A Resilient, Compliant Cloud:reliability as a product, with availability targets, failover, recovery objectives, multi-region resilience, and certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2 that make trust a reason to buy.
  • The Platform Behind OPSWAT’s Cloud Services:one API and platform that web proxy and ICAP protection, MetaDefender Secure Storage, email security, MetaDefender for Salesforce, and the threat-hunting tier build on.
  • Performance & Cost Efficiency:industry-leading speed to verdict, and a cost-per-scan discipline that protects margin as volume grows. You own the unit economics.
  • Technology Partners & Developer Ecosystem:the program for engine partners who strengthen detection, integration partners who put our verdict where security teams work, and developers who build it into their own products.
  • Marketplaces & Distribution:taking the product where buyers already purchase: cloud marketplaces such as AWS and Azure, distribution channels, and reseller partners, plus new offerings, such as MetaDefender Private for dedicated deployments, as the market demands.

What You Will be Doing

  • Own the business:define and champion the vision, strategy, and roadmap for MetaDefender Cloud, and be accountable for growth, adoption, and commercial outcomes.
  • Own reliability as a product:make contractual SLAs (latency, availability, and recovery objectives) the standard across every tier, and drive high availability, automatic failover, and multi-region resilience from roadmap to contract.
  • Own compliance & regulation:maintain and extend our certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, and beyond) and the data-privacy and data-residency posture, so regulated buyers can say yes.
  • Run the platform for its stakeholders:treat the OPSWAT services built on the cloud (web proxy and ICAP, secure storage, email, Salesforce, threat hunting) as first-class customers, balancing their needs with one coherent platform.
  • Own pricing & packaging:design and maintain the prevention tier ladder, packaging, metering, and discount guidance, steward the one price book with your Aether counterpart, and monitor realization against list.
  • Drive cost efficiency:own cost per scan and the margin story, and make efficiency a continuous, measured program.
  • Lead the platform evolution:carry customers through major platform transitions, with migration paths that never ask them to break their integration, and retire legacy offerings cleanly.
  • Grow marketplaces & distribution:list the product on the cloud marketplaces where buyers already purchase, grow channel and reseller partnerships, and build the no-touch motion behind them.
  • Build the Technology Partners program:make joining the ecosystem a product action, with SDKs, API documentation, and automated onboarding and vetting, so every engine, integration, and developer partner adds detection, reach, or data.
  • Champion product-led growth:the product sells the product. Own every self-serve and paid-conversion motion, including from the free community, plus the inbound and digital funnels and the upgrade path.
  • Tailor the experience to the persona:know the cloud architect, platform engineer, and enterprise security leader in financial services, SaaS, and technology, and shape onboarding, console, and API experiences around their daily work.
  • Enable the field & measure ROI:own sales enablement and the proof the field needs, show up at the anchor events that matter, work channel partners deliberately, and hold every motion to a strong ROI.
  • Monitor the business:track the KPIs that matter (tier mix, NDR and GDR, realization, platform performance, unit cost) and use them to steer investment.
  • Build and lead the team:lead, mentor, and grow the MetaDefender Cloud product team, small and senior today, and scale it as the business scales.
  • Communicate with stakeholders:clearly articulate strategy, progress, and results to internal teams, executive leadership, and customers, fostering alignment and enthusiasm.

What We Need from You

  • Product management experience:5+ years in product management of cloud or SaaS products, ideally in cybersecurity or another trust-critical enterprise service. Experience leading product managers is a strong plus.
  • Cloud-service operating depth:you have run a high-availability, multi-tenant cloud service as a product (SLA and SLO design, recovery objectives, failover, multi-region architecture) and are credible with SRE and platform engineering.
  • Compliance & regulatory fluency:hands-on experience taking a cloud product through certifications such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS, and shaping data-privacy and data-residency posture for regulated buyers.
  • Business-owner fluency:demonstrated ability to run a product line as a business (packaging, pricing models, metering, unit economics), with fluency in NDR, GDR, and recurring-revenue metrics.
  • Marketplace & channel experience:you have grown a product through cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), channel, or reseller partners, or built that motion from zero.
  • Platform product thinking:experience evolving a shared platform that multiple products build on, balancing reuse with each consumer’s speed and autonomy.
  • Product-led growth:experience with self-serve, developer-facing offerings: onboarding funnels, API-first products, and conversion into enterprise contracts.
  • Persona-driven product craft:a track record of building experiences around sharply defined users, backed by research, usage data, and design partnership.
  • AI-first ways of working:an AI-first mindset: you actively apply AI tools to your own and your team’s daily work to move faster and raise quality.
  • Hands-on and technical:comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with R&D day to day, engaging credibly on APIs, cloud architecture, and trade-offs, and going deep in the product.
  • Track record of delivery:proven experience managing products from concept through launch, with results in user adoption, revenue growth, or market penetration.
  • Analytical & decisive:strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a data-driven approach.
  • Exceptional communicator:outstanding interpersonal and executive communication skills, enabling collaboration across cross-functional teams and credibility with customers and leadership.
  • Travel:willingness to travel regularly to field events, customers, and R&D sites.
  • Education:Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
  • Ways of working:familiarity with Agile methodologies or similar frameworks.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Own the prevent half of a focused two-product strategy at a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader: a trust-critical cloud with executive attention.
  • Reliability, compliance, and cost are the product here. Rare scope for a leader who wants to own an enterprise cloud end to end.
  • Shape a platform: the cloud you run is the foundation a growing family of OPSWAT services builds on.
  • Take a proven product into marketplaces, self-serve, and a partner ecosystem. The growth levers are yours to build.
  • Work hands-on with world-class global R&D teams on a service that protects critical infrastructure.
  • Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

jobs.description:
Overview

High Tide is a leading cannabis retailer and eCommerce company with a portfolio of brands across North America and Europe.

Our portfolio includes Canna Cabana, one of Canada's largest cannabis retail chains, along with leading eCommerce brands including Smoke Cartel, Daily High Club, FAB CBD, NuLeaf Naturals, and more.

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple campaigns at once, and enjoys bringing marketing initiatives from planning through execution.

This role will have a strong focus on email marketing calendar management, digital campaign coordination, and paid media support across multiple brands. You'll work closely with the Digital Marketing Manager and cross-functional teams to keep campaigns on schedule, coordinate required inputs, support campaign execution, and help ensure marketing initiatives launch accurately and on time.

You'll own the coordination and maintenance of email marketing calendars across multiple brands and play an important project management role across broader digital marketing campaigns. Experience working with paid media campaigns and performance marketing is also highly valued.

The role will additionally support affiliate marketing through partner outreach, campaign coordination, asset sharing, and day-to-day communications under the direction of the Digital Marketing Manager. Previous affiliate experience is helpful, but deep affiliate program ownership is not required.

You'll also support website marketing initiatives, reporting, and other digital marketing projects as needed.

Please note: This is a remote contractor position based in São Paulo, Brazil, supporting our North American business operations and working EST hours. High Tide does not operate a physical office in Brazil.

English fluency is required. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Portfolios are ideally submitted in English; however, Portuguese portfolios will also be accepted.

Responsibilities

Email Marketing & Calendar Management

  • Own and maintain email marketing calendars across multiple brands.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and ensure required inputs, approvals, creative assets, product information, and other dependencies are completed on schedule.
  • Work cross-functionally with Category Management, Pricing, Creative, eCommerce, Analytics, and Marketing teams to keep campaigns moving forward.
  • Support the planning, QA, scheduling, and deployment of email campaigns.
  • Help coordinate promotional, retention, lifecycle, and automated email marketing initiatives.
  • Monitor email performance and report on key campaign KPIs.
  • Support A/B testing and ongoing email optimization.
  • Maintain campaign documentation, timelines, and workflows.
  • Identify scheduling risks, missing information, or dependencies early and escalate them appropriately.

Omni-channel Marketing Campaign Project Management

  • Coordinate multiple marketing campaigns and initiatives simultaneously across brands.
  • Develop and maintain campaign timelines, task lists, deliverables, and project documentation.
  • Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure deadlines and campaign requirements are met.
  • Coordinate creative briefs, campaign requirements, approvals, and asset delivery across teams.
  • Help ensure campaign messaging and execution are aligned across email, paid media, affiliate, and digital channels.
  • Participate in campaign planning meetings and translate decisions into clear next steps and deliverables.
  • Track campaign progress and proactively flag risks, delays, or missing dependencies.
  • Support promotional launches and other cross-functional marketing initiatives from planning through execution.

Paid Media & Performance Marketing

  • Support the planning, execution, and optimization of paid media campaigns across digital channels.
  • Monitor campaign performance across metrics such as ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversions, and revenue.
  • Coordinate campaign requirements, audience needs, promotional information, and creative assets with internal teams and external partners.
  • Support the development of creative briefs and paid campaign requirements.
  • Review campaign performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Provide recommendations based on creative, messaging, audience, and campaign performance.
  • Support competitor monitoring and promotional analysis.
  • Assist with paid media reporting and campaign insights for the Digital Marketing Manager and marketing leadership.

Affiliate Marketing Support

  • Support affiliate marketing initiatives under the direction of the Digital Marketing Manager.
  • Conduct outreach to prospective affiliate partners, publishers, influencers, and other potential partners.
  • Support affiliate partner onboarding and ongoing communications.
  • Coordinate promotional opportunities and campaign requirements with affiliate partners.
  • Ensure partners receive required creative assets, promotional details, links, and campaign information on time.
  • Help maintain affiliate contact lists, outreach records, campaign documentation, and partner communications.
  • Support affiliate reporting and help identify notable partner or campaign trends.
  • Assist with day-to-day affiliate program administration as required.

Website & Digital Marketing Support

  • Support website marketing campaigns, promotional activations, landing pages, and other digital initiatives as required.
  • Coordinate website campaign requirements with internal teams.
  • Participate in broader digital campaign planning and execution across multiple brands.

Reporting & Analysis

  • Support reporting across email marketing, paid media, affiliate initiatives, and broader marketing campaigns.
  • Prepare regular campaign performance summaries and reporting.
  • Identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring further investigation.
  • Use campaign data to support recommendations and future planning.
  • Maintain campaign tracking and reporting documentation.
  • Utilize AI tools to support campaign analysis, competitive research, reporting, and marketing workflows.
  • Apply critical thinking and business judgment when reviewing data, recommendations, and AI-generated outputs.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, ideally within eCommerce, retail, agency, or another fast-paced multi-campaign environment.
  • Strong experience managing email marketing calendars and campaign workflows across multiple campaigns, brands, or clients.
  • Experience building, scheduling, QAing, or deploying email campaigns using platforms such as Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with demonstrated experience coordinating marketing campaigns across multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
  • Experience supporting or executing paid media campaigns, with an understanding of common paid media performance metrics and optimization principles.
  • Experience developing campaign briefs and coordinating requirements with designers, copywriters, agencies, or other marketing partners.
  • Ability to manage multiple brands, campaigns, projects, or client accounts simultaneously.
  • Experience with affiliate marketing, publisher outreach, influencer partnerships, or affiliate platforms is considered an asset but is not required.
  • Experience with platforms such as Impact, Awin, Minty, ShareASale, Refersion, or similar is considered an asset.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign performance and identify actionable insights.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing information, risks, and dependencies.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Experience with eCommerce and social media marketing is considered an asset.

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Work across some of the most recognized brands in cannabis, CBD, and accessories.
  • Take ownership of email calendars and help coordinate high-volume digital marketing campaigns across multiple brands.
  • Build hands-on experience across email marketing, paid media, affiliate partnerships, eCommerce, and broader digital campaigns.
  • Collaborate with teams across North America and Europe.
  • Help bring campaigns seen by millions of customers to market.
  • Join a fast-growing company where strong organization, initiative, and ownership are valued.
  • Build experience across multiple brands and digital marketing disciplines.

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your resume (in English).
  • Any relevant portfolio, case studies, or examples of digital marketing work.

We are particularly interested in examples related to email marketing, campaign/project management, paid media, campaign reporting, or other digital marketing initiatives.

Examples of affiliate marketing work are welcome but are not required.

Portfolios are ideally submitted in English; however, Portuguese portfolios will also be accepted.

About Us

High Tide Inc. is the leading community-grown, retail-forward cannabis enterprise engineered to unleash the full value of the world’s most powerful plant and is the second-largest cannabis retailer globally by store count⁷. High Tide (HITI) is uniquely-built around the cannabis consumer, with wholly-diversified and fully-integrated operations across all components of cannabis, including:

  • Bricks & Mortar Retail: Canna Cabana™ is the largest cannabis retail chain in Canada, with 230 plus current locations spanning British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and growing. In 2021, Canna Cabana became the first cannabis discount club retailer in the world.
  • Retail Innovation: Fastendr™ is a unique and fully automated technology that employs retail kiosks to facilitate a better buying experience through browsing, ordering and pickup.
  • Consumption Accessories: High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory e-commerce platforms across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.
  • E-commerce Platforms: High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory sites across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.

Brands: High Tide’s industry-leading and consumer-facing brand roster includes Queen of Bud™, Cabana Cannabis Co™, Daily High Club™, Vodka Glass™, Puff Puff Pass™, Dopezilla™, Atomik™, Hue™, Evolution™ and more.

CBD: High Tide continues to cultivate the possibilities of consumer CBD through Nuleafnaturals.com, FABCBD.com, blessedcbd.de and blessedcbd.co.uk.

Wholesale Distribution: High Tide keeps that cannabis category stocked with wholesale solutions via Valiant™.

Licensing: High Tide continues to push cannabis culture forward through fresh partnerships and license agreements under the Famous Brandz™ name.

High Tide consistently moves ahead of the currents, having been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 by the Globe and Mail’s Report on Business Magazine, and was named as one of the top 10 performing diversified industries stocks in both 2022 and 2024 TSX Venture 50. High Tide was also ranked number one in the retail category on the Financial Times list of Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies for 2024.

Narvar is Growing! Narvar is a multi-language platform, and we’re intentional about where we apply Rust. We’re looking for senior engineers to help us bring Rust into the backbone of the system — the parts that must be fast, safe, and correct under real-world scale.

This role is for engineers who want agency: people who enjoy identifying the right problems, choosing the right tools, and owning systems end-to-end. You won’t be handed a narrow ticket queue. You’ll help decide what gets built and how it should be built.

For this role, you should be located in Canada and able to work within EST/EDT or PDT/PST hours. We are fully remote.

Day-to-day

  • Design and build high-correctness Rust services that sit on critical platform paths
  • Introduce Rust into areas where safety, determinism, and performance are essential
  • Own systems from architecture → implementation → rollout → operations
  • Make real decisions around concurrency, async boundaries, data integrity, and failure modes
  • Work across service boundaries in a polyglot environment (Rust alongside other stacks)
  • Collaborate with product, design, and frontend engineers to build systems that are technically sound and product-aware
  • Improve reliability, observability, and system behavior through design, not just patching
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar on system quality and ownership

What We’re Looking For

We care more about judgment and ownership than credentials.

You’re likely a strong fit if you:

  • Have built and operated distributed systems in production
  • Have deep hands-on Rust experience (not just experiments or side projects)
  • Understand where Rust shines — and where it doesn’t
  • Are comfortable reasoning about concurrency, async systems, and correctness guarantees
  • Have experience designing APIs and data contracts that evolve safely over time
  • Have worked with relational and/or NoSQL databases at scale
  • Have deployed and operated services in AWS or GCP (We are a GCP Shop though!)
  • Take initiative naturally and are comfortable operating with ambiguity
  • Communicate clearly and make tradeoffs explicit

Bonus Points

These aren’t hard requirements, but strong indicators:

  • You’ve worked in startup or high-ownership environments
  • You’ve owned systems in production, including on-call responsibility
  • You’re comfortable moving across the stack when needed (backend-first, full-stack aware)
  • You’ve influenced architecture by earning trust, not by mandate
  • You use modern tooling (including AI-assisted workflows) to increase leverage, not outsource thinking

(Note: we care about outcome and judgment, not how flashy your tools are.)

Why Rust at Narvar?

Because some parts of the system deserve stronger guarantees.

We use Rust where:

  • Bugs are expensive
  • Latency and throughput matter
  • Safety and correctness are non-negotiable

You’ll help define where Rust belongs, not just write Rust in isolation.

Why Narvar (From an Engineer’s Perspective)?

  • Teams that value thinking, judgment, and responsibility

Low ego, high trust, and room to do your best work

From the hottest new direct-to-consumer companies to retail’s most renowned brands, Narvar works with GameStop, Neiman Marcus, Sonos, Nike, and 1300+ + other brands. With hubs in San Francisco, Atlanta, London, and Bangalore, we've served over 125 million consumers worldwide across 10+ billion interactions, 38 countries, and 55 languages.

Job Title: Campaign Organizing Strategist

Department: Campaigns

Location: Los Angeles (preferred) or remote in California

This position requires an ability to travel.

Reports To: Campaign Manager

Context: At the Sierra Club, we believe in the power of interdependence. Together, we remain committed to the fight for a healthy climate built on a foundation of environmental, racial, economic, and gender justice – a future where all people benefit from a healthy, thriving planet and a direct connection to nature. As the climate crisis and deeply entrenched systemic racism all fuel injustice, we will continue to fight for a bold, transformational agenda that recognizes the interconnectedness between our planet, our humanity, and our future. By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 800 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.

Scope: The Campaign Organizing Strategist is responsible for designing the campaign organizing component of strategic planning in collaboration with the manager and Chapter Director. The Campaign Organizing Strategist supports the planning and coordination of campaigns which win real victories and build the grassroots power to accomplish Sierra Club priorities, which are: to address climate disruption, transform the energy economy, protect communities from pollution, ensure access to the outdoors for all and protect our lands, water and wildlife. The Chapter(s) is a crucial partner for the Campaign Organizing Strategist to successfully carry out strategic plans.

The Campaign Organizing Strategist works closely aligned with volunteers, partners, and staff across states, while harnessing all of the strategic levers of Sierra Club including legal, communications, digital strategies and subject matter/campaign expertise. The Campaign Organizing Strategist coordinates and guides the team of organizers and volunteer teams, ensuring successful implementation of campaign goals, and robust collaboration in alignment with and supported by the manager. The Campaign Organizing Strategist will work with state leadership to develop state based, regional,and local strategies, coordinate implementation plans with the field teams, communicate priorities and track metric benchmarks.

The Campaign Organizing Strategist provides leadership to volunteer and staff organizers in the state(s), fosters volunteer leadership and shapes the leadership ladder, participates to produce educational materials, presentations and reports, research, testifies, lobbies and develops subject matter expertise on relevant topics. The Campaign Organizing Strategist is empowered to represent the Sierra Club to government officials, the media and other organizations, including coalition spaces.

Job activities include but are not limited to:

    1. Campaign Strategy and Implementation: Works closely with the Deputy Director, Chapter Director and Campaign teams to design the creation of state or multi-state strategic planning, and facilitates the organizing strategy, balancing national and state Sierra Club priorities. Works to incorporate key state and chapter stakeholders, including volunteers, to create and implement a campaign of the overarching strategic plan. This includes leading the creation of multi-issue state campaign plans, organizing tactics, conducting or overseeing research, developing engagement strategies, facilitating organizing meetings, volunteer integration, and developing and leveraging partnerships. Tracks policy and regulatory proceedings in the state that are relevant to a specific campaign, identifies opportunities for engagement, mobilization, or intervention. Ensuring that campaigns are rooted in equity and justice and inclusive of frontline and directly impacted communities. May be asked to consult or support on budget, fundraising, and large scale strategic planning.

    2. Campaign Team Leadership. Creates a state (or multi-state) campaign team space to support and coach organizers, track campaign progress, and create a positive team culture with the support and guidance of the manager. Guides team members to develop campaign plans to achieve outcomes in the state. Ensures that organizers have access to resources and uses expertise to support the training team to develop and facilitate training on the craft of organizing and key campaigning skills. Supports organizers to effectively deliver on grassroots campaigns which win real victories and build the grassroots power of Sierra Club. Works with the Campaign team to determine and track metrics and progress towards campaign goals, provides metric guidance and support..

    3. Collaboration. Builds a healthy, mutually accountable relationship with Chapter staff and volunteers to carry out Sierra Club priorities. Communicates clear expectations, capacity, and works in strategic alignment to accomplish Sierra Club’s priority goals. Prioritizes relationships with volunteer leaders and coordinates with other Sierra Club stakeholders as needed.

    4. Volunteer Leadership Development. Support the development of a comprehensive volunteer development strategy to support volunteers from onboarding to leadership through training, coaching, and mentorship. Coordinate with state staff to support volunteer leadership development and organizing metrics. Identify and develop new and existing volunteers to support as they assume new leadership roles and build Sierra Club’s grassroots power and extend outreach into communities. Supports and trains volunteers on organizing skills and developing issue expertise. Develop volunteer leaders who are skillful at facilitating effective, healthy teams.

    5. Strategic Local Representation of Sierra Club. In coordination with state and Chapter staff and volunteers, develop or participate in strategic communication and grasstop engagement strategies and metrics. Represents Sierra Club priorities to public officials, partner organizations, and to the media. Maintains positive relationships with strategic partners, coalitions, members of the media, grassroots leaders, elected officials, and government officials when strategic and aligns with the strategic priorities in the state. As needed, serves as Sierra Club spokesperson to media outlets and promotes volunteer and partner organization media exposure.

    6. Build and Participate on Teams: Build, maintain, and participate on teams to advance state level specific campaign work and Chapter organization building. Develop volunteer leaders who are skillful at facilitating effective, healthy teams.

    Seasonal Activities:

    Heavier seasonal workloads may occur as a result of project deadlines, staff absences and vacancies, and during peak activity periods. Frequent weekend and/or evening work required.

The successful candidate must demonstrate the following skills, experience and competencies:

    • Campaign Leadership: Substantial experience as a field organizer, campaign strategist, and/orleading community organizing campaigns prior experience and/or demonstrated ability in developing, training, and coaching teams.. In-depth knowledge and experience of the craft of grassroots organizing, campaign development and implementation, and power building

    • Strategy Development and Campaign Planning: Substantial experience planning and managing a state or state campaign, including campaign planning, strategy development, integrating multiple strategies and tactics including organizing, policy, lobbying, communications, and working with senior level political and business leaders.

    • Effective Communication: Highly developed communication skills, with a focus on communicating effectively across different groups of stakeholders, internally and externally. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex ideas effectively and develop succinct, compelling calls to action.

      • Team Building: Demonstrated leadership experience leading a team of peers and working within a team structure collaboratively. Ability to build collective vision, trust, and mutual accountability with team members. Experience working closely with volunteers and developing volunteer leaders.

        • Data Practices: Experience using quantitative data (for example, numbers of people engaged) and qualitative data (for instance, stories about people taking action) to inform and evaluate organizing work. Experience building data accountability systems and supporting teams to track and measure the success of organizing tactics.

        • Committed to evolution. You are committed to continuously deepening and evolving your own understanding of systems of oppression through study, openness, and humility. And you easily recognize your own relationship to privilege and power, examining and shifting your behaviors as appropriate.

        • Uplifting and additive. You see mistakes as opportunities for growth; problems as catalysts for solutions, and inspire others along the journey. You carry a constructive approach, can-do attitude, a sense of humor, and authentic kindness wherever you go.

The strongest candidates will also demonstrate the following skills, experience and competencies:

    • Issue Expertise: Knowledge of environmental and energy issues, and either expertise or an ability to develop expertise in state energy, climate justice, and/or conservation areas.

    • Political Expertise: Knowledge of the political, policy, and regulatory landscape in the state. Best candidates will have relationships with some of the major players in business, organizations, and government.

    • Tech Competency: Working knowledge and experience with G-Suite, Zoom, Canva, Mobilize, and Hustle and the ability to learn new technology tools to support organizing and campaign goals. The ability to train and coach staff and volunteers on tools.

    • Demonstrates the ability to create rapport and inspire trust. Open to feedback and the ability to learn new skills.

      • This job description encompasses all of the functions held by this position. A realistic annual work plan will be developed based on the strategic priorities and campaign goals of the state and/or region. The work plan will be approved by this position’s manager and adjusted as needed throughout the year. Depending on the needs of the state and/or region, the (Position Name) may be doing some of these functions more than others. The work plan is the tool a manager will use to ensure there is clarity around expectations and work responsibilities.

To Apply

The Sierra Club provides equal employment and advancement opportunities to all staff members. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, lived experience and skills. jobs.description:
Overview of the role

We’re on a mission to modernize insurance, making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that has remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a Home & Auto Insurance Advisor to help us build the future of insurance in Canada and beyond.

As a Home & Auto Insurance Advisor, you’ll be on the front lines helping customers protect their homes and vehicles while delivering a modern, digital-first experience. You’ll focus on sales execution - handling inbound leads, closing business, and providing clear, honest advice that builds long-term trust with our customers. You’ll also collaborate with the rest of the team to refine our sales processes, share insights from customer conversations, and contribute to the continued growth of PolicyMe’s P&C business.

Reports To: Associate Director, Home & Auto

What you'll be doing

    First 6 months

  • Educate prospective customers on Home & Auto insurance options using PolicyMe’s digital platform and your product expertise, breaking down coverage in clear, honest terms so they feel confident moving forward.
  • Manage a high-volume, inbound pipeline of Home & Auto leads, moving them efficiently through the sales funnel and converting qualified opportunities into closed policies via phone, SMS, and email.
  • Use HubSpot to track every touchpoint - calls, emails, follow-ups, and deal stages - so your pipeline is always clean, up to date, and easy to forecast from.
  • Recommend the right coverage based on customer needs using a consultative, customer‑first approach that balances protection, price, and eligibility.
  • Build and refine sales scripts, talk tracks, objection‑handling, workflows, and follow‑up sequences in HubSpot to improve contact rates, appointment show rates, and close rates.
  • Work directly with engineering and product to refine client digital experiences and communicate how our products are performing.
  • Set the tone and standards for how PolicyMe serves P&C customers by delivering a high‑energy, high‑conversion, but always honest and customer‑centric experience on every interaction.
  • Ensure all recommendations and customer interactions are fully compliant with RIBO requirements, carrier guidelines, and internal policies.

    • 6–12 months and beyond

  • Establish yourself as a top‑performing Home & Auto advisor, consistently hitting and exceeding monthly sales and activity targets (contact rate, talk time, conversions etc).
  • Continuously optimize your own sales process by testing new hooks, discovery questions, and follow‑up cadences - and feeding winning approaches back into team playbooks.
  • Contribute to a scalable, repeatable sales playbook for Home & Auto by logging accurate data in HubSpot, surfacing common objections, and helping refine qualification criteria and next‑best actions.
  • Identify and act on bundle and cross‑sell opportunities with Life and Health & Dental, increasing overall premium per household while keeping customer needs and affordability front and center.
  • Help position PolicyMe as Canada’s go‑to digital‑first distributor of personal insurance by delivering an experience that feels modern, simple, and genuinely sales‑driven in the best sense: efficient, helpful, and outcome‑oriented.

What we are looking for

  • A licensed P&C advisor in Ontario (RIBO Level 1 or higher).
  • 3+ years of experience selling personal lines (Home & Auto), ideally in a high‑volume, phone‑based or digital sales environment.
  • A builder mentality - entrepreneurial and adaptable - with a track record of not just working a process but improving it (scripts, sequences, qualification, and follow‑up).
  • A proven track record of exceeding sales targets in a consultative sales environment, with comfort owning a full inbound pipeline from first contact to close.
  • Strong pipeline management and organization skills: you’re comfortable juggling a large volume of leads while maintaining tight follow‑up discipline and clean CRM hygiene.
  • Strong communication skills and a consultative sales style - you can manage objections, explain complex coverage concepts clearly, and make clients feel heard while still driving to a decision.
  • High empathy and discretion, especially when discussing personal and financial details, paired with a clear sense of urgency and ownership over your numbers.
  • Comfort with CRM and workflow tools (HubSpot preferred) and a willingness to lean into data, playbooks, and feedback to continuously improve performance.
  • High ethical standards and a commitment to compliance, confidentiality, and always putting the customer’s best interests first - even while you’re chasing ambitious sales goals.
  • Experience at a digital‑first distributor is an asset.

Why join us:

  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance
  • Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $80,000–$90,000 CAD, based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

About PolicyMe:

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit .

Additional Notes:

  • Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience.
  • Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.
  • Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application.

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

About Mood Health

At Mood Health, we are working to make mental health care easier to access.

For many people, reaching out for help is one of the hardest steps they will take. Our mission is to make that first step feel simple, supportive, and welcoming.

Our clinicians provide therapy and psychiatric care through secure telehealth visits. Before a patient ever meets with a provider, they connect with one of our Patient Acquisition Specialists—the person who helps turn interest into action.

This role is more than customer service. It's consultative sales with purpose.

About the Role

We are looking for a Patient Acquisition Specialist to join our growingteam. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in healthcare sales, insurance sales, inside sales, admissions, or other high-performing customer acquisition/support roles.

You'll work with patients who have already expressed interest in receiving care through one of our healthcare partners. Your job is to build trust, understand their needs, answer questions, overcome barriers, and confidently guide them toward scheduling their first appointment.

Success in this role requires someone who enjoys connecting with people, thrives in a fast-paced sales environment, and is motivated by meeting and exceeding performance goals. While this is not cold calling, you should be comfortable managing a pipeline, following up consistently, and helping hesitant individuals move forward.

If you're competitive, goal-oriented, and passionate about helping people while building a career in healthcare sales, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Convert referrals into scheduled patients

Engage prospective patients who have been referred by our healthcare partners and guide them through the scheduling process from initial outreach to booked appointment.

Build relationships and earn trust

Use a consultative sales approach to understand each patient's needs, answer questions, and provide confidence as they begin their mental health journey.

Manage your sales pipeline

Own a high-volume referral pipeline by consistently following up through phone, text, email, and CRM tools to maximize conversion rates.

Overcome objections

Help prospective patients navigate concerns around insurance, scheduling, treatment options, or uncertainty about seeking care while providing an exceptional patient experience.

Achieve performance goals

Consistently meet or exceed booking, conversion, outreach, and response time goals while maintaining a high-quality patient experience.

Collaborate across teams

Partner with healthcare providers, referral partners, operations, and clinical teams to ensure a seamless patient experience.

Deliver an exceptional experience

Represent Mood Health professionally while creating positive first impressions that build long-term patient relationships.

What We're Looking For

  • Bilingual Spanish required
  • 2+ years of experience in sales/customer support & experience, preferably:
    • Insurance sales
    • Healthcare sales
    • Inside sales
    • High-volume call center sales
    • Customer acquisition
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales or conversion goals
  • Comfortable managing a sales pipeline and following up consistently
  • Strong objection handling and relationship-building skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to multitask across multiple systems while maintaining quality
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar
  • Familiarity with healthcare, insurance benefits, or behavioral health is a plus
  • HIPAA knowledge or experience working with confidential information preferred
  • Ability to work weekends as needed

What Makes Someone Successful

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy helping people make important decisions
  • Are energized by achieving goals and earning performance incentives
  • Take ownership of your pipeline and follow-up process
  • Can balance empathy with confidence
  • Love building relationships over the phone
  • Stay positive and persistent when following up with prospective patients
  • Are coachable and always looking to improve your performance

Why Join Mood Health

Make a meaningful impact

Every appointment you schedule helps someone access life-changing mental health care.

Performance-based earning potential

Competitive base salary with uncapped or meaningful bonus opportunities tied to booking and conversion performance.

Join a growing sales organization

Become part of a high-performing sales team with ongoing coaching, development, and opportunities to advance into leadership or other commercial roles.

Career growth

As Mood continues to expand nationally, you'll have opportunities to grow into senior sales, team lead, training, partnership, or management positions.

Pay:
$20—$22 USD

jobs.description:
You will be the most senior hands-on application security engineer at Cleo, owning both how security is built into our products from design through release and the security posture of the products we ship, both on-premise and SaaS, as our customers experience them. This is a Staff-level individual contributor role with real program ownership: you set the standards, build the guardrails, and work directly with engineers in the code. You report to the CISO and partner daily with Engineering, and our Cloud Security team. You are not a one-person department: security engineers and consulting partners execute under your direction. Your job is to set direction, make the hard technical calls, and build leverage through automation and partners rather than carry every task yourself.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Secure development lifecycle and guardrails

  • Own and mature Cleo’s SSDLC: security requirements, threat modeling, and design reviews for high-risk product changes, APIs, and integrations.
  • Run and tune SAST, SCA, secrets detection, container, and IaC scanning.
  • Build reusable secure patterns, reference implementations, and policy-as-code controls that make the secure path the default path.
  • Own developer security enablement: Security Champions meeting, deliver the engineering security training campaigns, grow a named champion in every squad, and give developers practical remediation guidance, office hours, and self-service security capabilities.

Product vulnerability management

  • Run risk-based triage, remediation, and verification for application and product vulnerabilities, including remediation SLAs, escalation, and exceptions. Reproduce externally reported vulnerabilities against running product instances and validate patches before release.
  • Own the penetration testing program: scope and coordinate third-party engagements, perform targeted testing yourself, and validate findings through retesting.
  • Run our Vulnerability Disclosure Program, including researcher communications and coordinated disclosure.
  • Coordinate the CVE lifecycle for Cleo products and support product-security incident response.
  • Own the application and product-security controls in Cleo's NIST CSF 2.0 program: track maturity, close gaps, and produce the evidence our audits rely on.

Product security

  • Own the security posture of the products Cleo ships, across SaaS and customer-hosted deployment models: secure defaults, authentication and session controls, RBAC and tenant isolation, admin data access, security-relevant configuration, and hardening guidance for customers.
  • Own the Product Security Roadmap: partner with Product Management, the CTO, and Architecture to get security features prioritized and shipped, including SSO/SAML upgrades, the in-app RBAC redesign, endpoint-level access control, and customer-requested controls, and represent security in RTE Sync and Boundary Review.
  • Be the technical owner for customer-facing product security: triage customer vulnerability-scan findings and penetration-test reports against Cleo products, answer security RFIs and enhancement requests, and author customer-facing advisories, security release notes, and hardening documentation.

AI Fluency Competencies

  • Own threat modeling and security review for LLM-enabled product features, AI agents, and AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Build controls and secure patterns for prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, insecure output handling, excessive agency, insecure tool integrations, and AI supply-chain risk.
  • Apply and operationalize the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework across product and engineering.

Prerequisites

  • 6+ years in application security, product security, or secure software engineering, including experience building or maturing an AppSec program across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong object-oriented developer: Strong proficiency in an object-oriented programming language is required, with Java preferred given Cleo’s core products are Java-based. You should be able to read, debug, and write production-quality code and be comfortable working across languages such as TypeScript, Python, or Go.
  • Deep knowledge of application attack surfaces: authentication, authorization, API security, business-logic flaws, and modern service architectures.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and tuning SAST, SCA, and secrets scanning in GitHub and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on exploit reproduction and patch validation: you can take a researcher's report of a pre-authentication vulnerability, reproduce it against a running Java web application, confirm the fix, and write up what the researcher and the customer each need to hear.
  • Coordinated disclosure experience with external security researchers and customers, including holding an embargo timeline and driving a CVE to publication.
  • Product security experience on shipped software with an installed base: secure defaults and hardening guidance, customer-facing advisories and security release notes, and turning a customer's scan report or RFI into a fix-or-explain response.
  • Experience running threat modeling, design reviews, and manual security testing, and working directly with developers through remediation.
  • Clear communicator who can turn technical risk into engineering guidance for both developers and executives, and who can hold a release-gating decision with Engineering leadership when the risk warrants it.

Nice to Have

  • Securing LLM applications, AI agents, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • SBOM (CycloneDX/SPDX), VEX, artifact signing, and SLSA.
  • AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Terraform, Jenkins.
  • Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security, Semgrep, Burp Suite.
  • NIST CSF 2.0, OWASP SAMM/ASVS, NIST SSDF; supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.
  • CSSLP, OSWE, GWAPT, AWS Security, or comparable certifications.
  • Enterprise software with both SaaS and customer-hosted deployment models; SSO/SAML, RBAC design, and multi-tenant isolation; MFT/EDI or other B2B integration products.
