jobs.description:
About Canvas Medical: Canvas Medical is on a mission to reimagine healthcare technology. Our platform provides a modern, developer-friendly electronic medical records (EMR) system, enabling better patient care and empowering healthcare innovators. By combining cutting-edge technology with a deep understanding of clinical workflows, we’re transforming how healthcare is delivered.
Role Overview: As a Developer Advocate at Canvas Medical, you will be the voice of the developer community and a bridge between external developers and our internal product teams. Your primary goal will be to champion the needs of developers integrating with Canvas Medical’s API, provide technical guidance, and ensure our developer tools and documentation empower users to build impactful healthcare applications. This role is ideal for a technical communicator passionate about healthcare innovation and developer enablement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Community Engagement: Build and nurture relationships with the developer community through forums, social media, webinars, and meetups. Act as the primary point of contact for external developers, collecting feedback and sharing insights with internal teams.
  • Technical Advocacy: Create and maintain high-quality documentation, tutorials, sample code, and SDKs to support developers using Canvas Medical’s API. Collaborate with the product and engineering teams to enhance API usability based on developer feedback.
  • Content Creation: Write blog posts, produce videos, and deliver presentations showcasing best practices, new features, and real-world applications of Canvas Medical’s API. Develop technical content for hackathons, developer conferences, and community events.
  • Support and Enablement: Provide direct support to developers, helping them troubleshoot issues and optimize their integrations. Conduct workshops, office hours, and training sessions to onboard developers to the Canvas Medical platform.
  • Evangelism: Represent Canvas Medical at conferences, trade shows, and other industry events as a technical expert and advocate. Share the vision of Canvas Medical and its impact on healthcare innovation.

Qualifications

  • Technical Expertise: Proficient in programming languages like Python, JavaScript, or similar, with experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs. Familiarity with FHIR standards is a plus.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for a broad audience.
  • Healthcare Knowledge: Understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, EMR systems, and developer challenges in health tech is highly desirable.
  • Developer Focused: Proven track record of engaging with developer communities or contributing to open-source projects.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
Viseven Group — міжнародна MarTech компанія, що спеціалізується на інтерактивному контенті та хмарних рішеннях для глобальних фармацевтичних компаній з 2009 року. Постійне зростання та саморозвиток закладені в нашій корпоративній ДНК. Наші унікальні розробки та підходи активно використовуються більш ніж у 50 країнах світу. Рішення Viseven представлені на великих галузевих заходах у Барселоні, Філадельфії, Лондоні тощо.
Команда, яка швидко зростає, включає понад 700+ висококваліфікованих технічних і нетехнічних експертів: front- і back-end розробників, BA фахівців та менеджерів, які створюють, локалізують і налаштовують програми у офісах по всьому світу: Житомир (Україна), Таллінн (Естонія), Познань (Польща), Нью-Делі (Індія), Бриджвотер (США).

Обов'язки:

  • Перетворювати стратегію продуктової лінійки на конкретні беклоги команди та валідувати результати спринтів для забезпечення стабільного виконання.
  • Володіти та постійно пріоритизувати беклог команди, щоб зусилля розробки фокусувалися на найцінніших завданнях, які відповідають цілям продукту.
  • Визначати цілі спринтів, брати участь у плануванні спринтів та координувати роботу з командою для забезпечення реалістичних зобов'язань.
  • Керувати змінами обсягу робіт та вхідними запитами під час спринтів, комунікувати зміни зі стейкхолдерами та відповідно коригувати плани спринтів.
  • Забезпечувати, щоб доопрацювання беклогу командою узгоджувалося зі стратегією та пріоритетами продукту, валідуючи результати.
  • Співпрацювати з Product Management та стейкхолдерами для вдосконалення функцій продукту на основі підтверджених ринкових та клієнтських інсайтів.
  • Координувати роботу бізнес-аналітиків, системних аналітиків та інших ролей на етапі дослідження (discovery), забезпечуючи чіткість та технічну реалізованість вимог.
  • Допомагати з наданням вимог команді, якщо мета та обсяг зрозумілі.
  • Планувати релізи (на рівні команди) у співпраці з Engineering Manager (PO визначає обсяг → EM координує виконання).
  • Брати участь у приймальному тестуванні функцій та демонстраціях для перевірки якості та повноти.
  • Брати участь та співкерувати ретроспективами спринтів разом з EM, ініціюючи покращення командних практик.
  • Керувати процесом виявлення ризиків та шляхами ескалації (PO визначає продуктові ризики → EM керує ризиками постачання).
  • Виступати основним експертом (SME) для внутрішніх стейкхолдерів, надаючи необхідний контекст для якісних релізів.
  • Валідувати проєктні плани та документацію для стейкхолдерів за потреби (у співпраці з DM).
  • Встановлювати та підтримувати співпрацю з веб-департаментом та іншими командами, коли потрібна крос-продуктова робота.
  • Координувати крос-командні епіки та забезпечувати узгодженість щодо спільного функціоналу.
  • Працювати з інструментом Estimator, отримувати погодження та підтримувати процес оцінювання (EM оцінює → PO/DM погоджує).
  • Співпрацювати з QA для класифікації проблем (інцидент чи покращення) та пріоритизувати баги в Product Backlog на основі впливу на бізнес.

Вимоги:

  • 3+ роки досвіду на позиції Product Owner, Product Manager, Delivery Manager або на подібних ролях
  • 2+ роки досвіду у сфері Pharma, Life Sciences або фармацевтичного маркетингу (в IT/tech середовищі) — процеси та системи ланцюга постачання контенту (створення контенту, MLR, CRM, Veeva, AEM, SFDC)
  • Підтверджений успішний досвід визначення та запуску продуктів, що відповідають бізнес-цілям
  • Досвід роботи з продуктами на основі AI/ML, включно з розумінням життєвого циклу моделей, метрик оцінювання та обмежень, таких як упередженість (bias) та галюцинації
  • Впевнене володіння Jira, Confluence та методологіями Agile/Scrum
  • Досвід написання user stories, критеріїв приймання (acceptance criteria) та технічних специфікацій
  • Знання технік оцінювання (story points, T-shirt sizing)
  • Рівень англійської мови — Upper-Intermediate або вище

Що ми пропонуємо?

Команда має для нас велике значення, тому ми цінуємо її та надаємо можливість кожному ділитися своїм баченням, втілювати власні ідеї, зростати у професійному середовищі, зберігаючи баланс між роботою та особистим життям.
Приєднавшись до Viseven, ви отримаєте:
· Конкурентоспроможну винагороду та регулярний перегляд заробітної плати
· Професійне та кар'єрне зростання
· Оплачувану відпустку - 18 робочих днів на рік (20 робочих днів після 2 років співпраці)
· Лікарняний без підтверджуючих документів - 4 робочих дні на рік
· Документально оформлений лікарняний - 20 робочих днів на рік
· Відпустку по сімейних обставинах - 3 оплачуваних робочих дні (у разі одруження, народження дитини або тяжкої втрати)
· Комплексне медичне страхування (включаючи курс масажів та фізіопроцедур)
· Курси вивчення англійської мови
· Можливість участі в професійних форумах і конференціях
· Регулярні корпоративні заходи та тімбілдінги
· Досвідчену команду та дружню атмосферу
· Приємне робоче середовище: комфортний, повністю обладнаний офіс та можливість працювати вдома

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation.
jobs.description:
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. We create modern, elegant front- and back-end tooling to enable new ways for developers and clinicians to integrate data, automate workflows, and collaborate to solve healthcare's toughest challenges. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.
Canvas is institutionally backed by some of the greatest technology investors in the world (funded notable health tech companies such as GoodRx, Oscar Health, and Hims & Hers Health).
Role Description
We're hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our Engineering team and build the technical bridge between customer needs and platform capabilities. This role is the engineering counterpart to our Solutions Consultants—where they translate customer needs into requirements, you'll transform those requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions that push the boundaries of our platform.
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll architect and implement custom solutions using the Canvas SDK, build reusable plugins and integrations, and extend our platform's capabilities to meet complex healthcare automation challenges. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to prototype rapidly, validate technical approaches, and deliver production-ready solutions that delight customers. This is a builder role where you'll directly impact how healthcare providers leverage our EMR platform while contributing to the evolution of our developer tools and SDK.
The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, passion for healthcare technology, and exceptional ability to navigate between rapid prototyping and production-quality code. You'll thrive in collaborative environments, balance customer urgency with engineering excellence, and drive technical decisions that scale. We're looking for someone who experiments fearlessly, iterates quickly, and can build elegant solutions from the ground up while maintaining the robustness required for healthcare systems.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Solution Development
  • Build production-ready solutions using the Canvas SDK, demonstrating mastery of event-driven architectures, handlers, and effects
  • Transform PRDs from Solutions Consultants into elegant, maintainable code that solves real healthcare workflow challenges
  • Create robust plugins and integrations that extend platform capabilities while maintaining HIPAA compliance and clinical documentation standards
  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable components and patterns that accelerate future solution delivery
  • Platform Enhancement & Innovation
  • Identify gaps in SDK capabilities and contribute directly to platform improvements through pull requests and feature development
  • Design and implement new SDK features that enable broader solution patterns across the customer base
  • Build developer tools and utilities that improve the efficiency of both internal teams and external developers
  • Create technical documentation, integration guides, and reference implementations for complex solutions
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership
  • Partner with Solutions Consultants to validate technical feasibility and architect optimal approaches
  • Collaborate with core engineering teams to align custom solutions with platform roadmap and architectural standards
  • Enable customer success through technical workshops, debugging sessions, and solution handoffs
  • Mentor Solutions Consultants on technical concepts and best practices for SDK usage

Qualifications

  • Required Experience & Background
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2+ years of professional software development experience with modern web stacks
  • Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end solutions from requirements to production deployment
  • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges
  • Technical Skills & Capabilities
  • Proficiency in Python is mandatory.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React preferred) are a bonus.
  • Experience with API design, event-driven architectures, and plugin-based systems
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, testing practices, and code maintainability
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping while maintaining production-quality standards
  • Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows
  • Healthcare & Domain Expertise
  • Interest in healthcare technology and improving clinical workflows through automation
  • Understanding of healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7) or willingness to learn quickly
  • Ability to translate clinical requirements into technical architecture decisions
  • Appreciation for the complexity and criticality of healthcare systems
  • Personal Attributes
  • Builder mentality—passionate about creating solutions that directly impact users
  • Collaborative approach to problem-solving with strong communication skills
  • Growth mindset with ability to learn new technologies and domains rapidly
  • Pragmatic engineering approach—knows when to build for today versus tomorrow
  • Customer empathy with drive to understand and solve real user problems
  • Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  • Experience building or maintaining SDKs, developer tools, or platform products
  • Background in healthcare IT, EMR integrations, or clinical systems
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements (HIPAA, FDA guidelines) for healthcare software
  • Experience with Python for backend services or data processing
  • Prior experience in customer-facing engineering or solutions architecture roles
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical community engagement

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • Ship 5+ production-ready solutions that demonstrate deep understanding of the Canvas SDK and platform capabilities
  • Contribute at least 2 meaningful enhancements to the SDK or developer tools based on customer solution needs
  • Establish strong working relationships with Solutions Consultants and become go-to technical partner for complex implementations
  • Create technical documentation and reference implementations that enable self-service solution development

Growth Path

Solutions Engineers at Canvas have multiple growth trajectories. Within 12-18 months, high performers evolve into senior solutions engineers who architect our most complex customer implementations and drive platform strategy. Many transition into core platform engineering roles, bringing deep customer context to shape product development. Others grow into technical leadership positions, building and scaling our solutions engineering practice. This role offers unique exposure to both customer challenges and platform internals, positioning you to influence Canvas's technical direction and healthcare impact.

Location

Remote/San Francisco/Washington DC
We are a fully remote, distributed team but encourage in-person collaboration in our office in San Francisco, or one of our satellite locations which for this role is in Washington DC. We encourage people to do their work when and where they perform at their best. Because of this structure, strong written communication skills, time management skills, and personal accountability are very important to us.
Canvas Medical provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

This is a craft role for someone early in their career who is genuinely excited about sales psychology, training, and the mechanics of how complex B2B SaaS deals get won. You'll work directly with the Head of Global Sales Enablement and have visibility across the entire commercial organisation.

Where this role grows

Over time, this role is designed to grow into a seller-facing enablement partner. You'll progress from building narratives and training in the background to standing alongside Account Executives in live customer meetings — running product demos, presenting our story to prospects, and supporting sellers directly in the room. To get there, you need to be comfortable presenting and want to develop into a confident, customer-facing voice for TrustYou. Presentation skill is not optional in this role — it is central to the career path.

WHAT YOU'LL DO.....

  • Build the sales narrative. Translate marketing assets (decks, launches, one-pagers, campaigns) into seller-ready sales narratives, pitch flows, and talk tracks.

  • Train our sellers. Design and deliver training on sales psychology, discovery, objection handling, and MEDDIC-style qualification — both live and async.

  • Run the content engine. Own and continuously improve the enablement content library, Salesforce-linked playbooks, and onboarding tracks for new hires.

  • Co-present the weekly Sales Deep Dive. Help present and co-present our weekly Sales Deep Dives to the global commercial team — product updates, competitive intel, customer stories, and narrative refreshes. This is a recurring, high-visibility stage that builds the presentation muscle this role needs.

  • Partner with Marketing. Work hand-in-hand with Product Marketing on every launch so sellers are ready on day one — not week six.

  • Measure and improve. Track what's working — ramp time, content usage, win rate by play — and use it to sharpen the next training cycle.

  • Get in the room. Grow into a seller-facing partner: join Account Executives on live customer calls, present TrustYou's story to prospects, and run product demos alongside the sales team.

You are a perfect fit, if you have…

  • 1–2 years of experience in B2B sales (SDR/BDR or junior AE) and/or marketing — ideally in a SaaS environment.

  • Completed studies in Business Management, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC sales methodology.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, Excel, and Word.

  • Business-level English (additional European languagesdata/AI for narrative — you can read a one-pager and instantly see how a seller would actually pitch it.

Ideally, you also have…….

  • Exposure to hospitality, traveuest experience software.

  • Hands-on experience with Gong, Clari, Highspot, or similar enablement tooling.

  • A second European language (German, French, Spanish, or Italian).

  • A good design eye — comfortable making slides and one-pagers that actually look professional.

TrustYou is a leading AI-driven hospitality platform dedicated to transforming guest experiences and empowering businesses to thrive. With a multicultural team of over 120 professionals working remotely across the globe, we help companies grow by achieving customer excellence.

jobs.excerpt: Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web.
jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.

The opportunity

We've seen firsthand how powerful in-person community connection can be — from our flagship Meetabase in Argentina to customer-hosted events in Madrid, and casual bar meetups organized when team members travel through Europe. We're ready to take this to the next level, and we're looking for someone who can help us think and operate at a different scale.   • Coordinate informal and formal meetups and community visits globally

    • Operations and measurement

  • Own all event logistics: venue sourcing and negotiation, catering, AV, signage, swag, guest lists, and international shipping

  • Manage event budgets, vendor relationships, and procurement across multiple time zones and currencies

  • Define and track KPIs for every event type — from attendance and engagement to pipeline influence and community NPS — and report out regularly

  • Gather attendee feedback — quantitative and qualitative — and synthesize insights to continuously raise the bar on quality and impact

  • Build and maintain playbooks, templates, and toolkits so programs can be handed off, replicated, and improved over time

  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Success Engineering on branding, messaging, and lead handoff

What you bring

  • Experience in event management, community marketing, or field marketing at a tech company, with a track record of owning both large flagship events and smaller programmatic ones

  • Experience managing a diverse portfolio of event formats — conferences, executive programs, community events, meetups — not just one type

  • Comfortable with international logistics: foreign vendors, cross-border shipping, multi-currency payments

  • Confident negotiator with vendors and venues; familiarity with contracts and procurement

  • Self-starter who thrives in a remote, async environment with high autonomy

  • Ability to travel internationally when needed

  • Bonus: experience in SaaS, data analytics, or open-source communities

  • Bonus: fluency in additional languages (Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, etc.)

Why this role matters

    This role is the strategic engine behind how Metabase shows up for its community in the real world. Every event you design is both a relationship-builder and a learning opportunity — a chance to deepen connections, surface honest feedback, generate new evangelists, and test what actually moves the needle. You're not just running events; you're building a program that compounds over time.

Compensation
The US base salary range for this role is $72.8K–$186K annually, plus equity and benefits.
Compensation is determined by role, level, location, and individual qualifications, including skills, experience, and scope of responsibility. Pay may vary by geographic location and other job-related factors.

Benefits
We offer meaningful equity and a comprehensive US benefits package, including fully employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance (with 75% coverage for dependents), a 401(k) with employer match available to enroll after the first 30 days, flexible and unlimited paid time off including sick time, and an asynchronous, remote-first environment.
We're a global team (50% outside the US), fully distributed (from Thailand to California), who get things done asynchronously, with plenty of uninterrupted time, supporting each other to do the best work of our careers. We offer flexibility (define your own schedule and work from wherever you want), autonomy, and an environment that fosters growth, learning, and development. jobs.excerpt: In a nutshellWe are looking for an Infrastructure Solutions Architect to provide architecture leadership for cloud hosting capabilities, with a primary focus on AWS and strong, practical knowledge of Azure.
jobs.description:
In a nutshell

We are looking for an Infrastructure Solutions Architect to provide architecture leadership for cloud hosting capabilities, with a primary focus on AWS and strong, practical knowledge of Azure. The role ensures that infrastructure designs for new and existing initiatives align with Eurofins policies, security requirements, and established design patterns defined at enterprise level by the Global Architecture Office.

This position covers the full lifecycle: requirements gathering (functional and non-functional), solution design, architecture approval, transition to operations, and Business-as-Usual (BAU) support. The architect actively participates in incident/problem management and is expected to join the out-of-hours manager pool for major incidents.

You will join an Infrastructure Support Crew and collaborate closely with other experienced Infrastructure Architects to ensure consistency and quality across designs and initiatives.

The team operates within enterprise architecture governance and follows direction, standards, and policies defined by the Eurofins Architecture Office.

Key Focus Areas

  • Architecture/design authority (~95%) with limited hands-on engineering (~5%)
  • Design approver: validate that application/infrastructure designs comply with Eurofins policies and approved patterns
  • Influence AWS landing zone architecture including segmentation and connectivity patterns (standardised hub-and-spoke)
  • Enable and support deployment, hosting, maintenance, and management of solutions in AWS, aligned with enterprise identity hosted in Azure
  • Kubernetes-enabled platforms: strong knowledge of Kubernetes from infrastructure and networking perspectives
  • C4 model diagramming as the standard for architecture communication
  • DevOps mindset required; Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) understanding is a plus
  • Provide additional architecture support for enterprise networking across office sites (physical LAN/WAN/Wi‑Fi) and cloud networking in AWS and Azure, including segmentation and hybrid connectivity.

Responsibilities

A) Architecture & Design Authority

  • Lead infrastructure solution design for AWS-hosted workload
  • Approve designs and ensure alignment with enterprise policies and reference architectures; collaborate with application architects to ensure end-to-end coherence
  • Ensure designs incorporate identity and access integration with enterprise identity hosted in Azure (e.g., single sign-on/federation concepts)
  • Create and maintain architecture artifacts using the C4 model and supporting HLD/LLD documentation
  • Embed and enforce Zero Trust access concepts into infrastructure and platform designs by defining secure access patterns in coordination with Security

B) Kubernetes & Platform Architecture

  • Design and govern Kubernetes-based hosting platforms and workloads, including cluster architecture, networking (ingress/egress), segmentation, and connectivity patterns
  • Define operational requirements for Kubernetes environments: observability, upgrade strategy, capacity, resilience, and security baselines

C) BAU, Incident/Problem Management & Operational Excellence

  • Participate actively in BAU operations, including major incident and problem management, driving root-cause analysis and follow-up improvements
  • Join the out-of-hours manager pool for escalations and critical incidents, coordinating technical response and ensuring timely restoration
  • Define and improve management frameworks for cloud services (monitoring, logging, backup, patching, lifecycle management, performance and reliability KPIs)
  • Drive automation and standardisation to reduce repetitive operational work and improve service consistency

D) Governance, Documentation & Stakeholder Management

  • Work as part of an Infrastructure Support Crew to apply and promote enterprise architecture standards and governance defined by the Eurofins Architecture Office.
  • Engage stakeholders (primarily security-related solutions owners) to gather requirements, communicate trade-offs, and define roadmaps
  • Maintain high-quality documentation: policies/procedures as applicable, architecture decisions, HLD/LLD, and operational runbooks
  • Mentor and support technical teams
  • Promote reusable patterns and consistent implementation approaches
  • Coordinate with key vendors when needed to stay aligned with platform capabilities and best practices
  • 5–10 years of experience in infrastructure engineering/operations and/or infrastructure architecture
  • Strong experience designing and operating AWS environments, including networking, segmentation, and connectivity patterns
  • Working knowledge of enterprise network architecture (LAN/WAN/Wi‑Fi), network security concepts, and hybrid connectivity between office sites and cloud environments.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Azure, especially identity foundations and enterprise integration requirements
  • Kubernetes knowledge is required (platform and networking aspects)
  • Proven ability to produce clear architecture documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable using the C4 model for architecture diagrams
  • Strong English communication skills

Nice-to-Have:

  • Understanding of Infrastructure as Code and Terraform concepts (modules, state, lifecycle); hands-on coding not required
  • Good understanding of DevOps practices for infrastructure delivery (version control, CI/CD principles, automated validation)
  • Experience in security-sensitive or highly governed environments
  • Familiarity with TOGAF (or a comparable enterprise architecture framework) and comfort applying a structured method to architecture decision-making, governance, and documentation.
  • Relevant certifications (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform)

What We Offer:

  • Permanent position in a global, fast-growing organisation
  • The opportunity to gain increased areas of responsibility and personal (career) development
  • Challenges within a multi-cultural and cross-regional team as part of the international and fast-growing Eurofins organisation
  • A dynamic working environment with a good team spirit where personal development and growth are encouraged
  • Opportunity to work on security-related platforms and cloud foundations at enterprise scale

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! The Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us!  We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more in our career page: 

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2023, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6,515 million, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.

WHO WE ARE

Outdoor Afro celebrates and inspires Black connections and leadership in nature. Our network also connects Black people with our lands, water, and wildlife through outdoor education, recreation, and conservation. Examples of Outdoor Afro’s year-round activities range from fishing, hiking, biking, kayaking, gardening, skiing and more! Visit: to learn more.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Reporting to the Executive Director, the Strategic Development & Partnerships Director oversees the strategy and operational excellence of Outdoor Afro’s partnerships and development efforts. In addition to driving revenue generation and partnership opportunities, the role emphasizes building strong departmental processes, managing donor relations technology, streamlining grant administration, and ensuring alignment between development operations and organizational goals development goals of the organization.

Who You Are

  • You're a seasoned mentor, having guided your teams to excellence and ensuring they reach their full potential.
  • Entrepreneurial at heart, you're adept at shaping policies and strategies from the ground up while thriving in dynamic environments.
  • A strategic partnership aficionado, you blend process efficiency with genuine relationship-building, understanding the twin pillars of successful fundraising.
  • Your personal outdoor experiences align with our mission, emphasizing the importance of Black connections with nature and advocating for equitable access.
  • Data-driven, you see the overarching picture, and value analytics just as much as interpersonal connections in driving development success.
  • An operations enthusiast, you're always seeking ways to refine processes and heighten efficiency.
  • Trust is your watchword, and you cherish every relationship – from major donors to volunteers, understanding the intricate value of each.
  • Passionate about technology, you harness donor management tools to streamline operations and extract meaningful insights.
  • An empathetic leader, you motivate with understanding and collaboration, fostering an environment where every voice matters.
  • Adaptable and proactive, you revel in change, always ready to evolve for the organization's betterment.
  • Ever-curious, you're consistently exploring new trends, tools, and strategies in nonprofit operations and fundraising.

Fundraising and External Relationship Development

  • Collaborate closely with the CEO and Executive Director to shape and continuously refine long-term fundraising strategies, ensuring they align with the organization's overarching goals and set the groundwork for sustained funding sources.
  • Dive deep into the nuances of the fundraising process, leveraging data analytics and internal feedback to identify areas for improvement, and ensuring continuous enhancement of departmental operations.
  • Progressively take on a pivotal role in donor relationship management, eventually becoming the primary lead, allowing the organization's Founder to focus on high-level strategic endeavors and broad organizational vision.
  • Foster and nurture existing funder relationships, using advanced donor management tools to ensure consistent, impactful interactions and expanded recurring revenue streams.
  • Draw from data insights within donor relation platforms to discern vital trends, uncover fresh opportunities, and effectively guide and support donor engagements.
  • Oversee grant compliance and reporting, while coordinating with internal team members to ensure that grant utilization aligns seamlessly with available operational resources and organizational goals.
  • Lead the planning and execution of fundraising events, ensuring that event logistics harmoniously integrate with development objectives, while also ensuring that fundraising initiatives benefit from the most effective operational strategies and tools available.

Development Operations

  • Strengthen and optimize the business development department operations, processes, procedures, and infrastructure.
  • Oversee the implementation and management of donor relations software (e.g., Salesforce) to enhance donor engagement and improve data insights.
  • Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that can streamline development and fundraising operations.
  • Develop or refine development policies and procedures to ensure best practices. Create and continually refine fundraising SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the development department.
  • Collaborate with the CEO and senior management on financial planning, budgeting, cash flow, and other operational matters.
  • Coordinate closely with other departments to ensure seamless alignment of strategies and initiatives.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Partnership Management

  • Partner with the program team to integrate fundraising initiatives with organizational programs and events - serving as the primary partner owner for the organization.
  • Manage regular reporting on partner needs, and deliverables; elevate issues to the Executive Team.
  • Serve as the primary Outdoor Afro representative and point of contact for partners, donors and the internal team driving all communications and follow-up items - sharing widely with the team as necessary.
  • Work with other departments to ensure that fundraising strategies are synchronized with organizational capabilities, resources, and timelines.
  • Oversee the day to day operational management of the Outdoor Afro’s partner relationships, ensuring donor and partner retention annually.
  • Develop strong relationships with corporate partner representatives.
  • Apply a customer centric approach to strategically approach partnership goals, ensuring alignment with Outdoor Afro’s mission.
  • Serve as an internal partner representative for the larger Outdoor Afro team to identify partner needs, deliverables and regular communications
  • Escalate potential conflicts of interest or issues to the Outdoor Afro Executive Team in a timely fashion as needed.

Leadership & Strategy

  • Participate in, and plan strategy meetings with the CEO and executive management team regarding exigent communications, partnerships, and large events.
  • Supervise fund development staff and consultants; develop individual goals, provide ongoing feedback, one-on-one meetings and conduct performance assessments
  • Actively participate in and provide leadership for strategic plan implementation in collaboration with the CEO and key staff. Coach staff as they implement strategic initiatives pertaining to fund development and partnership strategies.
  • Maintain continuous lines of communication within the Outdoor Afro HQ staff; identify and implement solutions to key issues; keep the CEO informed of critical issues and identify solutions.
  • Provide organizational leadership, insight, and expertise to the CEO and senior management on financial planning, budgeting, cash flow and other policy matters.
  • Provide leadership to the Board of Directors and relevant committees to communicate critical fund development matters. Write reports, including quarterly reports to the Board of Directors and its various operating committees.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field such as Nonprofit Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Public Relations, or another relevant area.
  • Master's Degree (Preferred but not mandatory): Advanced degrees like an MBA, Master's in Nonprofit Management, or a related discipline a plus.
  • 8-10 years in fund and/or business development roles, w/ significant portion of time spent in leadership or managerial positions. Candidates with corporate sales, account management and corporate partnership development are encouraged to apply.
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing development department operations, including refining processes, implementing new technologies, and managing donor relations software.
  • Proven track record of successful fundraising, including cultivating and maintaining relationships, securing major gifts, planning fundraising events, and grant writing.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects and tracking key performance indicators; experience using project management software such as Asana.
  • Advanced skills in the G-Suite and/or MS Office. Experience managing donor relations software (CRM), Salesforce, or similar software is required.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Strategic Vision: Guides, inspires, & develops teams to align with departmental and organizational objectives. Envisions short and long-term fundraising goals in harmony with organization's mission.
  • Operational & Data Mastery: Understands how to streamline business processes for efficiency and effectiveness while harnessing insights from donor relations software to inform strategies.
  • Partnership & Relationship Building: Excels in building & maintaining strong ties with diverse stakeholders, from corporate partners to community organizations. Understands nonprofit and corporate dynamics, and bridges communication gaps effectively.
  • Technical Proficiency & Grant Management: Familiar with tools like Salesforce and the intricacies of grant sourcing, application, compliance, and reporting.
  • Budget Oversight & Project Management: Plans & manages budgets for organizational growth and adeptly oversees multiple projects for timely completion.
  • Communication & Collaborative Mindset: Clearly articulates ideas & strategies to all stakeholders and works closely with other departments, aligning fundraising with broader strategies.
  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: Identifies challenges & devises solutions in evolving environments, and pivots strategies responsively to changes.

jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

The Role

We’re looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive to join our growing commercial team.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting through to closing, helping beauty and wellness businesses unlock growth through Fresha’s platform.

This is a high-impact role suited to someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building relationships from scratch, and is motivated by hitting and exceeding targets.

What You'll Do

  • Own a high-volume sales pipeline from prospecting through to close
  • Generate new business through outbound (calls, email, walk-ins) and inbound leads
  • Run efficient, tailored demos that clearly communicate value
  • Close deals quickly while maintaining a high-quality customer experience
  • Understand SMB pain points and position Fresha as a growth solution
  • Build trust with business owners and decision-makers
  • Consistently exceed monthly targets and activity metrics
  • Maintain clean pipeline management and accurate forecasting in CRM
  • Share market insights to help refine messaging and product direction
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What We're Looking For

    • 2+ years of experience in SMB sales, business development, or account executive roles
    • Proven ability to hit or exceed quota in a high-velocity environment
    • Strong prospecting and closing skills (you’re comfortable owning the full cycle)
    • A natural hunter who is also confident running consultative conversations
    • Excellent communication skills—especially with small business owners
    • Highly organized and able to manage multiple deals at once
    • Comfortable in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in SaaS, marketplaces, or payments
      • Exposure to beauty, wellness, or local services industries

This Role Is a Great Fit if You

  • Enjoy high-activity, high-reward sales environments
  • Take ownership of your number and pipeline generation
  • Are motivated by closing consistently, not occasionally
  • Can balance speed with quality in customer conversations
  • You're competitive. You keep score and you want to win, but you also lift the people around you
  • You have a growth mindset. You want feedback, you act on it, and you get better every week
  • You're a self-starter. You don't need to be managed, you need to be supported and given room to perform
  • You're curious, ask great questions, and genuinely want to understand the businesses you're selling to
  • You're excited about being early.
    • Joining a rapidly scaling team means you'll have real influence on how we build and what we become.
    At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process

  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30m)
  • Skills & Experience - Virtual interview with one of our commercial leaders (45m)
  • Culture Fit - Video-call with the General Manager (30m)
  • Presentation - Interview with the Commercial leadership team (60m)
    • We aim to finalize the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Benefits

    • Work-life balance: 25 days of flexible leave that we encourage you to take.
    • Retirement: 401K with up to 3% match.
    • Insurance: Medical, up to 80% employer contribution.
    • Additional Perks: Wellness products/services Perkbox.
    • Dental, Vision, and life insurance.
    • Free Counseling.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

Descrição do trabalho

Atua no desenvolvimento e evolução dos componentes web do SDK unificado, garantindo a captura, validação e transmissão segura de dados provenientes de diferentes fontes, como imagens, documentos e sensores, preservando sua integridade durante toda a jornada até os serviços de backend.

É responsável pela implementação de mecanismos avançados de proteção contra fraudes digitais, incluindo detecção de injeção de conteúdo, adulteração de sessões, automação maliciosa e execução em ambientes virtualizados ou navegadores não confiáveis. Trabalha diretamente na camada cliente, considerada uma das superfícies mais críticas de exposição a ataques.

Colabora com equipes de Arquitetura, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Plataforma e Produto para transformar requisitos de segurança, confiabilidade e conformidade em soluções escaláveis e prontas para produção. Atua continuamente na otimização de performance, compatibilidade entre navegadores e dispositivos, observabilidade e telemetria, contribuindo para aumentar os níveis de confiança e assertividade dos motores de decisão de risco e fraude.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter componentes web críticos do SDK unificado utilizando JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Projetar e implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques digitais, automação e manipulação de ambientes de execução.
  • Criar soluções de detecção de navegadores headless, ambientes virtualizados, emuladores e ferramentas de fraude digital.
  • Garantir a comunicação segura entre componentes web, SDKs nativos e serviços de backend.
  • Implementar controles de integridade e validação dos dados capturados pelo SDK.
  • Desenvolver telemetria, métricas, logs e mecanismos de observabilidade para monitoramento contínuo da plataforma.
  • Realizar análises de performance e otimização da experiência de captura em diferentes navegadores e dispositivos.
  • Participar da definição de arquitetura, padrões de desenvolvimento e estratégias de segurança para aplicações client-side.
  • Conduzir revisões de código e apoiar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento na adoção de boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Investigar vulnerabilidades e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos mecanismos de prevenção a fraude e abuso.
  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript e TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento avançado em arquitetura e funcionamento interno de navegadores modernos.
  • Experiência com frameworks modernos de front-end como React, Angular ou Vue.js.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações web, incluindo OWASP Top 10, CSP, CORS, XSS, CSRF e autenticação segura.
  • Experiência com WebAuthn, fingerprinting de dispositivos e mecanismos de proteção client-side.
  • Conhecimento em detecção de automação de navegadores, ambientes virtualizados, emuladores e ferramentas de scraping.
  • Experiência na integração entre aplicações web e SDKs nativos mobile ou desktop.
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, protocolos de comunicação segura e criptografia aplicada.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade, monitoramento e análise de logs.
  • Vivência com processos de desenvolvimento ágil e práticas de DevSecOps.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em produtos de identidade digital, biometria ou prevenção à fraude.
  • Conhecimento em WebAssembly (WASM).
  • Experiência com análise comportamental e device intelligence.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de anti-tampering, anti-debugging e proteção de código cliente.
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e aplicações com requisitos críticos de segurança.
  • Conhecimento de soluções de captura documental, prova de vida ou onboarding digital.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de SDKs multiplataforma.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Mentalidade voltada para segurança, qualidade e confiabilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação para interação com times multidisciplinares.
  • Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e arquiteturais.
  • Senso de ownership e autonomia na condução de iniciativas estratégicas.
  • Interesse contínuo por pesquisa e evolução em cibersegurança, antifraude e tecnologias web emergentes.

A Serasa Experian é muito mais do que você imagina. Com o propósito de criar um futuro melhor, ampliando oportunidades para pessoas e empresas, no Brasil somos mais de 4 mil pessoas que atuam em diversos times e especialidades. Aqui, cada conhecimento e diversidade se complementa e você pode trabalhar no que mais ama, estamos comprometidos a construir uma cultura inclusiva e um ambiente no qual pessoas possam equilibrar a carreira com seus compromissos e interesses pessoais, prezando pelo bem-estar.

A gente se dedica muito em ser uma das melhores e mais inovadoras empresas para se trabalhar do país, possibilitando experiências e carreiras incríveis para nossas pessoas. Nossa forte abordagem de pessoas em primeiro lugar é reconhecida externamente por meio de diversas certificações de mercado: fomos premiados pelo Great Place To Work™ em 24 países e pela certificação internacional Top Employers, além de sermos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para jovens profissionais e contarmos com uma avaliação de 4,6 no Glassdoor. Cada reconhecimento nos indica que estamos no caminho certo, proporcionando um ambiente de trabalho cada vez melhor para nossos talentos.

jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Manager to come and join our global business.
Reporting directly to the General Manager of Europe, and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and potential partners, you will be 100% focused on bringing in new business development.
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge and wants to make an impact.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 1-2 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Croatian, English and another language is a bonus!
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
  • Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop

Added bonus

  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
  • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview process

  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • Skills & Experience - Video/In-person interview with Team Lead and General Manager (Europe) (45 mins)
  • Presentation - Video/In-person interview with General Manager (Europe) (75 mins)
    • We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

jobs.description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!
THE COMPANY
Blended Technologies is bringing modern SaaS to the wine industry. Our products will give winemakers the tools to manage all aspects of the winemaking process from grape to bottle, and will allow winery owners to optimize their business with tailored workflows, inventory tracking, tasting room management, direct-to-consumer sales, and CRM. We help owners and winemakers spend less time on tax and compliance paperwork and more time making great wine and keeping customers happy.
We are a fully-funded seed-stage startup rounding out our initial engineering team that is conceiving, designing, building, and bringing our product to market. We are offering competitive salary and benefits as well as single-digit-employee-number equity.
THE ROLE
Being one of the first engineering hires at a startup is a special thing – you’ll never have a greater impact, you’ll never have more opportunity, you’ll never get a bigger piece of the pie, and you’ll never have more fun. This position reports directly to an experienced CTO with decades of experience at Google, Netflix, Apple, Twilio and other tech-focused companies.
We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to help design and build our service from the ground up. You should have built big things before, have opinions about what works and what doesn’t, and can work independently on even bigger things. There isn’t always going to be a clear map that explains how to get where we want to go, so you should be comfortable trying to understand our customer needs really well, be given some UI sketches, a data schema, and coworkers to collaborate with, and be excited to figure out the rest from there.

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience at 2-3+ tech-focused companies
  • Expert knowledge of React/TypeScript
  • Expert knowledge of HTML/CSS
  • Solid grasp of UX design fundamentals and the ability to translate an idea into reasonable basic UI

The more experience with any/all of these, the better:

  • GraphQL
  • Chakra or another UI component toolkit
  • React Native
  • Solid knowledge of HTTP protocol
  • Even more UX design skills than mentioned above
  • Writing GraphQL resolvers on the backend
  • MongoDB
  • AWS Cognito/Lambda/DocumentDB/API Gateway/CloudFormation
  • Writing good technical documentation
  • Working knowledge of managed cloud-service software development, esp. AWS
  • Working knowledge of building software in containerized deployments, with full CI/CD
  • A passion for leading and mentoring engineers
  • A desire to work directly with customers (winemaker customer visits are pretty great)

As recruiters helping to build the next generation of industry disruptors, we are committed to expanding the startup ecosystem so that exceptional talent from diverse communities can gain greater access to more early stage companies.
We work only with equal opportunity employers who welcome candidates from underrepresented, underestimated, and traditionally overlooked communities to further diversity, equity, and inclusion in the next cohort of industry-disrupting unicorns.

jobs.description:
Description

Reports to: Director of Sales Operations

About Us

Novee is the AI penetration testing platform built for a world where attackers operate at machine speed. Founded in Tel Aviv in April 2025 by a team with decades of nation-state offensive security experience - including veterans of Unit 8200, Iron Dome, and elite zero-day research - we're turning that expertise into a platform that thinks like a real attacker, runs continuously, and uncovers the novel vulnerabilities that manual testers and scanners miss.

We raised $51.5M in four months, backed by top investors YL Ventures, Canaan Partners, and Oren Zeev - one of the fastest funding trajectories in offensive security. Our proprietary AI model outperforms frontier LLMs by over 55% on real exploitation benchmarks, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for exceptional people to join our mission: making continuous, intelligent offensive security the new standard.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced Revenue Systems Administrator with strong hands-on expertise in both HubSpot and Salesforce to support Novee’s growing go-to-market organization.

A key responsibility of this role will be helping lead and execute the transition from HubSpot to Salesforce, including system configuration, data migration, process mapping, testing, and user adoption. You’ll work closely with Sales Operations and other go-to-market teams to ensure the transition is structured, accurate, and aligned with the company’s business needs.

Beyond the migration, you’ll own the day-to-day administration of our revenue systems and help bring structure, consistency, and visibility to our CRM environment. This includes building dashboards and reports, creating workflows and automations, maintaining data quality, and supporting the systems and processes behind our sales and marketing activities.

Novee participates in approximately 30-40 marketing events annually, each requiring dedicated campaign setup, tracking, and reporting. You’ll help ensure these campaigns and their associated data flows are built correctly and provide meaningful visibility into performance and pipeline generation.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on position for someone who enjoys organizing complex systems, solving operational challenges, and building scalable processes in a fast-growing environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support and execute the transition from HubSpot to Salesforce, including system configuration, process mapping, data migration, testing, validation, and user adoption.
  • Own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and maintenance of HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • Clean, organize, and standardize existing CRM data, processes, properties, fields, workflows, and permissions.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and forecasting views that provide actionable insights to Sales Operations and company leadership.
  • Design and implement workflows, automations, lead-routing processes, lifecycle stages, and data-management rules.
  • Manage CRM data migration and synchronization while maintaining data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Build and manage HubSpot and Salesforce campaigns supporting approximately 34 annual marketing events, including campaign setup, attribution, tracking, and reporting.
  • Partner closely with Sales Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to translate business requirements into scalable system solutions.
  • Maintain integrations between the CRM platforms and other go-to-market tools.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and provide ongoing support and guidance to CRM users.
  • Create clear documentation for system configurations, workflows, processes, and user guidelines.
  • Identify gaps and inefficiencies in the existing CRM environment and proactively recommend and implement improvements.
  • Establish scalable CRM governance and best practices as the company continues to grow.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience administering both HubSpot and Salesforce.
  • Proven experience supporting or leading a migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, including data mapping, migration, validation, and system configuration.
  • Strong understanding of CRM architecture, sales processes, marketing operations, pipeline management, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience building workflows, automations, dashboards, reports, campaigns, custom fields, objects, and permission structures.
  • Experience managing large volumes of CRM data and maintaining strong standards for data quality and governance.
  • Experience configuring marketing campaigns, campaign attribution, lead tracking, and event-related workflows.
  • Ability to translate business and operational requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of systems that require significant structure and improvement.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and leadership.
  • Ability to work regularly during U.S. business hours.
  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or fast-growing technology company is a strong advantage.
  • Salesforce Administrator certification and/or HubSpot certifications are a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with CRM integrations, APIs, data-import tools, and revenue technology platforms is a strong advantage.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to lead a critical CRM transition and shape Novee’s revenue systems from the ground up.
  • Significant ownership over the systems, processes, and data supporting a rapidly growing global go-to-market organization.
  • Close collaboration with Sales Operations and direct exposure to Sales, Marketing, Finance, and company leadership.
  • A collaborative and supportive environment that values initiative, problem-solving, accountability, and ownership.
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technology at the intersection of AI and offensive cybersecurity.
  • The excitement of joining a fast-growing company and making a direct, meaningful impact on its operational scale and success.

jobs.description:
Summary

You are a thoughtful marketing operations leader who enjoys building scalable systems, developing high-performing teams, and turning complex marketing needs into clear, efficient execution. You’re energized by working at the intersection of campaign operations, marketing technology, data, automation, and cross-functional collaboration. You enjoy solving ambiguous problems, improving how teams work, and helping marketers deliver accurate, measurable campaigns that support business growth.

At Yelp, our mission is to connect people with great local businesses. Marketing Operations plays an important role in bringing that mission to life by enabling lifecycle and revenue-driving marketing campaigns that are reliable, data-driven, and scalable. In this role, you’ll lead a team responsible for campaign enablement, marketing automation, QA, troubleshooting, MarTech operations, deliverability, and web operations. You’ll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Technology, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Creative, and other cross-functional teams to ensure our marketing systems, workflows, and digital experiences support strong execution and measurable impact.

We’re looking for an experienced people leader with hands-on marketing automation expertise and strong operational judgment. You should be comfortable managing team planning over a three-month-plus horizon, prioritizing work based on business impact, coaching team members through complex operational and technical challenges, and coordinating work across partner teams. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What you'll do:

  • Lead and develop a Marketing Operations team responsible for campaign enablement, marketing automation, QA, deliverability, troubleshooting, MarTech operations, workflow improvement, and select marketing web operations work.
  • Manage planning, prioritization, and execution across a three-month-plus horizon, ensuring the team’s campaign and operational backlog is clearly tied to business priorities, lifecycle goals, stakeholder needs, and measurable outcomes.
  • Oversee end-to-end campaign operations, including intake, scoping, sprint planning, requirements gathering, timeline management, QA readiness, launch coordination, post-launch issue resolution, and performance feedback loops.
  • Partner with Marketing Technology, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing, Creative, and Campaign Operations to maintain scalable, reliable, and AI-enabled MarTech infrastructure, including requirements for automation, personalization, audience segmentation, data flows, integrations, reporting, and operational workflows.
  • Own platform health, deliverability, and issue resolution processes by staying ahead of changes in marketing platforms, privacy policies, device operating systems, AI-driven filtering, and broader industry best practices; lead root cause analysis and coordinate rapid resolution of platform, campaign, data, deliverability, or tracking issues.
  • Support marketing web operations as a part of the role, including coordination of landing page updates, CMS workflows, deployment readiness, tagging and tracking implementation, accessibility considerations, performance monitoring, launch QA, and troubleshooting for marketing-owned digital surfaces.
  • Drive continuous improvement through AI, automation, experimentation, and scalable workflows, identifying opportunities to reduce manual work, improve campaign quality, strengthen analytics, and increase team productivity while maintaining accuracy, compliance, and operational control.

What it takes to succeed:

  • You have several years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, marketing automation/technology, web operations, or a related function.
  • You have experience managing or formally leading team members, including coaching, prioritizing work, providing feedback, supporting development, and creating a positive, accountable team environment.
  • You are hands-on with marketing automation platforms such as Braze, SFMC, Marketo or similar systems, and understand campaign logic, audience segmentation, personalization, QA, deliverability, reporting, and data-driven campaign execution.
  • You are comfortable with MarTech infrastructure and technical operations, including automation, data flows, integrations, reporting requirements, platform troubleshooting, UAT coordination, and working with Product, Engineering, Analytics, or Marketing Technology partners.
  • You bring strong project management and communication skills, including requirements gathering, timeline management, stakeholder alignment, risk mitigation, escalation management, and the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business language.
  • You have practical familiarity with AI, automation, experimentation frameworks, or advanced analytics, and are excited to apply emerging technologies responsibly to improve campaign operations, channel performance, workflow efficiency, and team scalability.
  • Experience designing or rolling out AI-powered workflows, automation playbooks, campaign QA tools, intake automation, experimentation workflows, web QA processes, or reporting systems.
  • You have working knowledge of marketing web operations, such as CMS workflows, landing page QA, tracking implementation, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, conversion pixels, UTM governance, accessibility considerations, Core Web Vitals, or collaboration with technical teams on web releases.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with SQL, structured data, campaign data models, APIs, integrations, or data pipelines.
  • Experience with enterprise CMS platforms or website management tools such as WordPress, Drupal, Adobe Experience Manager, Contentful, Webflow, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with front-end web concepts such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, redirects, metadata, page templates, or structured content.
  • Experience developing channel analytics frameworks, deliverability benchmarks, operational scorecards, web performance dashboards, or reporting that informs campaign optimization and prioritization.

What you'll get:

  • Effective your first day: Full medical, vision, and dental
  • 15 days PTO (accrual begins on date of hire and increases with 2+ years of tenure thereafter), 12 paid holidays, plus one floating holiday
  • Up to 14 weeks of parental leave
  • Monthly wellness subsidy
  • Work from home reimbursement
  • Flexible spending account
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Compensation range for this position is $109,000 - $184,000 annually. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Closing

At Yelp, we believe that diversity is an expression of all the unique characteristics that make us human: race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, and education — and those are just a few. We recognize that diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our teams and our product.
